paragraphs: Revolucija 14. julija, znana tudi kot iraški vojaški udar leta 1958, je bil vojaški udar 14. julija 1958 v Iraku, ki je strmoglavil kralja Fejsala II. in hašemitsko Kraljevino Irak. Iraška republika, ki je nastala po njem, je končala hašemitsko arabsko federacijo Iraka in Jordanije, ustanovljeno komaj šest mesecev prej.

source.title: 14 July Revolution
paragraphs: The 14 July Revolution, also known as the 1958 Iraqi military coup, was a military coup that took place on 14 July 1958 in Iraq, resulting in the toppling of King Faisal II and the overthrow of the Hashemite-led Kingdom of Iraq. The Iraqi Republic established in its wake ended the Hashemite Arab Federation between Iraq and Jordan that had been established just six months earlier.

Revolucija 17. julija (arabsko: inqilāb 17 Tammūz) je bil nekrvav državni udar v Iraku leta 1968, ki so ga vodili Ahmed Hasan al Bakr, Abd ar Razak an Naif in Abd ar Rahman al Davud. Odstavil je predsednika Abdula Rahmana Arifa in predsednika vlade Tahirja Jahjo ter na oblast pripeljal iraško regionalno vejo Arabske socialistične stranke Baath. Med baatisti, ki so sodelovali v udaru in poznejši čistki zmerne frakcije pod vodstvom Naifa, so bili Hardan al Tikriti, Salih Mahdi Amaš in poznejši iraški predsednik Sadam Husein. Udar je bil uperjen predvsem proti Jahji, odkritemu naseristu, ki je politično krizo po šestdnevni vojni junija 1967 izkoristil, da bi Arifovo zmerno vlado prisilil k nacionalizaciji družbe Iraq Petroleum Company (IPC) v zahodni lasti, da bi Irak lahko »nafto uporabil kot orožje v boju proti Izraelu«. Do popolne nacionalizacije IPC je prišlo šele leta 1972, pod baatistično oblastjo. Po udaru je nova iraška vlada utrdila oblast z obtožbami o domnevnih ameriških in izraelskih spletkah, med širšo čistko je zaradi izmišljenih obtožb vohunjenja javno usmrtila 14 ljudi, med njimi 9 iraških Judov, in krepila tradicionalno tesne odnose s Sovjetsko zvezo.

source.title: 17 July Revolution
paragraphs: The 17 July Revolution (Arabic: انقلاب 17 تموز, romanized: inqilāb 17 Tammūz) was a bloodless coup in Iraq in 1968 led by Ahmed Hassan al-Bakr, Abd ar-Razzaq an-Naif, and Abd ar-Rahman al-Dawud that ousted President Abdul Rahman Arif and Prime Minister Tahir Yahya and brought the Iraqi Regional Branch of the Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party to power. Ba'athists involved in the coup as well as the subsequent purge of the moderate faction led by Naif included Hardan al-Tikriti, Salih Mahdi Ammash, and Saddam Hussein, the future President of Iraq. The coup was primarily directed against Yahya, an outspoken Nasserist who exploited the political crisis created by the June 1967 Six-Day War to push Arif's moderate government to nationalize the Western-owned Iraq Petroleum Company (IPC) in order to use Iraq's "oil as a weapon in the battle against Israel." Full nationalization of the IPC did not occur until 1972, under the Ba'athist administration. In the aftermath of the coup, the new Iraqi government consolidated power by denouncing alleged American and Israeli machinations, publicly executing 14 people including 9 Iraqi Jews on fabricated espionage charges amidst a broader purge, and working to expand Iraq's traditionally close relations with the Soviet Union.

1860 civil conflict in Mount Lebanon and.headline: Državljanski spopad v Libanonskem gorovju in Damasku leta 1860
paragraphs: Državljanski spopad v Libanonskem gorovju in Damasku leta 1860, znan tudi kot krščansko-druzovska vojna leta 1860, je bil državljanski spopad v Libanonskem gorovju v času osmanske oblasti v letih 1860–1861, v katerem so se bojevali predvsem tamkajšnji Druzi in kristjani.

Po odločilnih zmagah Druzov in pokolih kristjanov se je spopad razširil v druge dele osmanske Sirije, zlasti v Damask, kjer so druzovski borci in krajevne muslimanske skupine pobili na tisoče kristjanov. Boji so sprožili mednarodno vojaško posredovanje pod francoskim vodstvom.

source.title: 1860 civil conflict in Mount Lebanon and Damascus
paragraphs: The 1860 civil conflict in Mount Lebanon and Damascus, also known as the 1860 Christian–Druze war, was a civil conflict in Mount Lebanon during Ottoman rule in 1860–1861 fought mainly between the local Druze and Christians.

Following decisive Druze victories and massacres of the Christians, the conflict spilled over into other parts of Ottoman Syria, particularly Damascus, where thousands of Christian residents were killed by Druze fighters and local Muslim groups. The fighting precipitated a French-led international military intervention.

1920 capture of Damascus.headline: Zavzetje Damaska leta 1920
paragraphs: Zavzetje Damaska leta 1920 je bila zadnja faza francosko-sirske vojne, v kateri so francoske sile skoraj brez odpora zavzele Damask. Arabsko kraljestvo Sirija je bilo konec, začel je veljati francoski mandat za Sirijo. Kmalu zatem, septembra 1920, je Damask postal prestolnica države Damask pod francoskim mandatom.

Vojna Hašemitov proti Francozom, ki je izbruhnila januarja 1920, se je za novo razglašeno Arabsko kraljestvo Sirija kmalu sprevrgla v uničujoč pohod. Kralj Fejsal se je v skrbeh zaradi posledic dolgega krvavega boja s Francozi 14. julija 1920 sam vdal, a njegovo sporočilo ni prišlo do vojnega ministra Jusufa al Azme, ki je kralja prezrl in povedel vojsko k Majsalunu, da bi Sirijo branil pred francoskim prodorom. Bitka pri Majsalunu se je končala s porazom Sircev. Francoske čete so nato krenile nad Damask in ga 24. julija 1920 zavzele.

source.title: 1920 capture of Damascus
paragraphs: The 1920 capture of Damascus was the final stage of the Franco-Syrian War in which French forces captured Damascus with little resistance. The Arab Kingdom of Syria was brought to an end, and the French mandate of Syria was put into effect. Shortly afterward, in September 1920, Damascus was established as the capital of the State of Damascus under a French mandate.

The war of the Hashemites against the French, which erupted in January 1920, shortly became a devastating campaign for the newly-proclaimed Arab Kingdom of Syria. Worried about the results of a long bloody fight with the French, King Faisal himself surrendered on 14 July 1920, but his message would not reach War minister Yusuf al-'Azma, who, ignoring the King, led an army to Maysalun to defend Syria from the French advance. The Battle of Maysalun resulted in a crushing Syrian defeat. The French troops later marched on Damascus and captured it on 24 July 1920.

1921 Persian coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Perziji leta 1921
paragraphs: Iranski državni udar leta 1921, v Iranu znan kot državni udar 3. esfanda 1299 (po perzijskem sončnem koledarju), označuje več velikih dogodkov v kadžarskem Iranu leta 1921, ki so nazadnje pripeljali do odstavitve dinastije Kadžarov in do tega, da je leta 1925 vladajoča rodbina Irana postala dinastija Pahlavijev.

Dogodki so se začeli 22. februarja 1921 z udarom perzijske kozaške brigade pod vodstvom Reze kana. Natančen obseg britanske vpletenosti v udar je še vedno predmet zgodovinske razprave, skoraj gotovo pa je Edmund Ironside zarotnikom svetoval. Z udarom je oblast prevzel Zia ol Din Tabatabai, ki je postal predsednik vlade. Udar je bil večinoma nekrvav in je naletel na malo odpora. Reza kan je z okrepljenimi silami in kozaško brigado uspešno vojaško odpravil separatistična in uporniška gibanja v Tabrizu, Mašhadu in gibanje Džangali v Gilanu. Pohod proti Simku in Kurdom je bil manj uspešen in je trajal globoko v leto 1922, čeprav se je nazadnje končal z iranskim uspehom.

source.title: 1921 Persian coup d'état
paragraphs: 1921 Iranian coup d'état, known in Iran as 3 Esfand 1299 coup d'état (Persian: کودتای ۳ اسفند ۱۲۹۹ with the Solar Persian date), refers to several major events in Qajar Iran in 1921, which eventually led to the deposition of the Qajar dynasty and the establishment of the Pahlavi dynasty as the ruling house of Iran in 1925.

The events began with a coup by the Persian Cossack Brigade headed by Reza Khan on 22 February 1921. The precise level of British involvement in the coup remains a matter of historical debate, but it is almost certain that Edmund Ironside provided advice to the plotters. With this coup Zia ol Din Tabatabaee took over power and became prime minister. The coup was largely bloodless and faced little resistance. With his expanded forces and the Cossack Brigade, Reza Khan launched successful military actions to eliminate separatist and dissident movements in Tabriz, Mashhad and the Jangalis in Gilan. The campaign against Simko and the Kurds was less successful and lasted well into 1922, though it eventually concluded with Iranian success.

1941 Iraqi coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Iraku leta 1941
paragraphs: Iraški državni udar leta 1941 (arabsko: Thawrah Rašīd ʿAlī al-Kaylānī), imenovan tudi udar Rašida Alija al Gajlanija ali udar zlatega kvadrata, je bil nacionalistični državni udar v Iraku 1. aprila 1941, ki je strmoglavil probritanski režim regenta Abd al Ilaha in njegovega predsednika vlade Nurija al Saida ter za regenta postavil Šarafa bin Radžeha, za predsednika vlade pa Rašida Alija al Gajlanija.

Udar so vodili štirje iraški nacionalistični generali, znani kot »zlati kvadrat«, ki so hoteli vojno izkoristiti za pritisk za popolno neodvisnost Iraka po omejeni neodvisnosti, pridobljeni leta 1932. Zato so sodelovali z nemško obveščevalno službo in sprejeli vojaško pomoč nacistične Nemčije in fašistične Italije. Menjava vlade je pripeljala do britanske invazije na Irak in zasedbe, ki je trajala do leta 1947.

source.title: 1941 Iraqi coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1941 Iraqi coup d'état (Arabic: ثورة رشيد علي الكيلاني, Thawrah Rašīd ʿAlī al-Kaylānī), also called the Rashid Ali Al-Gaylani coup or the Golden Square coup, was a nationalist coup d'état in Iraq on 1 April 1941 that overthrew the pro-British regime of Regent 'Abd al-Ilah and his Prime Minister Nuri al-Said and installed Sharaf bin Rajeh as Regent and Rashid Ali al-Gaylani as Prime Minister.

The coup was led by four Iraqi nationalist army generals, known as "the Golden Square", who intended to use the war to press for full Iraqi independence following the limited independence granted in 1932. To that end, they worked with German intelligence and accepted military assistance from Nazi Germany and Fascist Italy. The change in government led to the British invasion of Iraq and subsequent occupation until 1947.

1953 Iranian coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Iranu leta 1953
paragraphs: Z državnim udarom 19. avgusta 1953 so strmoglavili iranskega predsednika vlade Mohameda Mosadeka in okrepili oblast iranskega šaha Mohameda Reze Pahlavija. Udar sta spodbudila Združeno kraljestvo (MI6) z operacijo Boot in Združene države (CIA) s projektom TP-AJAX oziroma operacijo Ajax. Ključni motiv je bila zaščita britanskih naftnih interesov v Iranu, potem ko je Mosadek leta 1951 nacionaliziral državno naftno industrijo.

source.title: 1953 Iranian coup d'état
paragraphs: On 19 August 1953 a coup d'état overthrew the Prime Minister of Iran, Mohammad Mosaddegh, strengthening the rule of Mohammad Reza Pahlavi, the Shah of Iran. It was instigated by the United Kingdom (MI6), under the name Operation Boot and by the United States (CIA), under the name TP-AJAX Project or Operation Ajax. A key motive was to protect British oil-interests in Iran after Mosaddegh had nationalized the country's oil industry in 1951.

1959 Mosul uprising.headline: Vstaja v Mosulu leta 1959
paragraphs: Vstaja v Mosulu leta 1959 se je začela s poskusom državnega udara arabskih nacionalistov v Mosulu, ki so hoteli odstaviti tedanjega iraškega predsednika vlade Abdula Karima Kasima in postaviti arabsko nacionalistično vlado, ki bi Republiko Irak pridružila Združeni arabski republiki. Ko je udar spodletel, sta se v Mosulu sesula red in zakon: več dni so potekali nasilni ulični boji med skupinami, ki so skušale izkoristiti kaos za poravnavo političnih in osebnih računov.

source.title: 1959 Mosul uprising
paragraphs: The 1959 Mosul Uprising started with an attempted coup by Arab nationalists in Mosul who wished to depose the then Iraqi Prime Minister Abdul-Karim Qasim, and install an Arab nationalist government which would then join the Republic of Iraq with the United Arab Republic. Following the failure of the coup, law and order broke down in Mosul, which witnessed several days of violent street battles between various groups attempting to use the chaos to settle political and personal scores.

Sirski državni udar leta 1963, ki ga baatistično zgodovinopisje imenuje revolucija 8. marca (arabsko: ثورة الثامن من آذار), je bil prevzem oblasti v Siriji, ki ga je izvedel vojaški odbor sirske regionalne veje Arabske socialistične stranke Baath. Načrtovanje in izvedbo zarote sirskih baatistov je spodbudil prevzem oblasti stranke Baath v Iraku februarja 1963.

source.title: 1963 Syrian coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1963 Syrian coup d'état, labelled in Ba'athist historiography as the March 8 Revolution (Arabic: ثورة الثامن من آذار), was the seizure of power in Syria by the military committee of the Syrian Regional Branch of the Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party. The planning and the unfolding conspiracy of the Syrian Ba'athist operatives were prompted by the Ba'ath party's seizure of power in Iraq in February 1963.

1966 Syrian coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Siriji leta 1966
paragraphs: V sirskem državnem udaru leta 1966 (21.–23. februarja) so vlado Sirske arabske republike strmoglavili in zamenjali. Vladajoče narodno poveljstvo Arabske socialistične stranke Baath je z oblasti odstranila zveza strankinega vojaškega odbora in sirske regionalne veje pod vodstvom Salaha Džadida.

Udar je sprožil zaostreni boj za oblast med staro gardo stranke, ki so jo zastopali Michel Aflaq, Salah al Din al Bitar in Munif al Razaz, ter radikalnimi levičarskimi frakcijami, privrženkami neobaatističnega stališča. Privrženci stare garde v vojski so 21. februarja ukazali premestitev tekmecev. Dva dni pozneje je vojaški odbor, ki je podpiral radikalne levičarske frakcije, sprožil udar z nasilnimi boji v Alepu, Damasku, Dejr ez Zorju in Latakiji. Zgodovinski ustanovitelji stranke so po udaru pobegnili iz države in preostanek življenja preživeli v izgnanstvu.

source.title: 1966 Syrian coup d'état
paragraphs: In the 1966 Syrian coup d'état (21–23 February) the government of the Syrian Arab Republic was overthrown and replaced. The ruling National Command of the Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party were removed from power by a union of the party's Military Committee and the Syrian Regional Branch, under the leadership of Salah Jadid.

The coup was precipitated by a heightening in the power struggle between the party's old guard, represented by Michel Aflaq, Salah al-Din al-Bitar, and Munif al-Razzaz, and the radical leftist factions adhering to a Neo-Ba'athist position. On 21 February, supporters of the old guard in the army ordered the transfer of their rivals. Two days later, the Military Committee, backing the radical leftist factions, launched a coup that involved violent fighting in Aleppo, Damascus, Deir ez-Zor, and Latakia. As a result of the coup, the party's historical founders fled the country and spent the rest of their lives in exile.

1970 Syrian coup d'etat.headline: Državni udar v Siriji leta 1970
paragraphs: Sirski državni udar leta 1970, imenovan tudi popravna revolucija (arabsko: Thawrat al-Tashih) ali popravno gibanje (al-Ḥarakah at-Taṣḥīḥīyya), je bil nekrvav vojaški državni udar, ki ga je 13. novembra 1970 v Siriji vodil general Hafez al Asad. Asad je obljubil, da bo ohranil in izboljšal »nacionalno socialistično linijo« države in stranke Baath. Stranka je ideološko revidirala svoja stališča in se odrekla nauku Salaha Džadida o izvažanju revolucij. Nova doktrina je poudarjala poraz Izraela z razvojem sirske vojske ob podpori Sovjetske zveze.
Asad je baatistični Siriji vladal do smrti leta 2000, nasledil pa ga je sin Bašar al Asad, ki je vladal do propada svojega režima decembra 2024.

source.title: 1970 Syrian coup d'etat
paragraphs: The 1970 Syrian coup d'etat, also called the Corrective Revolution (Arabic: ثورة التصحيح, romanized: Thawrat al-Tashih) or the Corrective Movement (Arabic: الحركة التصحيحية, romanized: al-Ḥarakah at-Taṣḥīḥīyya), was a bloodless military coup d'état led by General Hafez al-Assad on 13 November 1970 in Syria. Assad promised to sustain and improve the "nationalist socialist line" of the state and the Ba'ath Party. The Ba'ath party adopted an ideological revision, absolving itself of Salah Jadid's doctrine of exporting revolutions. The new doctrine placed emphasis on defeating Israel, by developing the Syrian military with the support of the Soviet Union.
Assad would rule Ba'athist Syria until his death in 2000, after which he was succeeded by his son Bashar al-Assad who in turn ruled until the collapse of his regime in December 2024.

1973 Israeli raid in Lebanon.headline: Izraelski napad v Libanonu leta 1973
paragraphs: V noči z 9. na 10. april 1973 so enote za posebne naloge izraelskih obrambnih sil napadle več ciljev Palestinske osvobodilne organizacije (PLO) v Bejrutu in Sidonu v Libanonu. Napad, znan kot operacija Pomlad mladosti, na splošno šteje za del operacije Božja jeza, izraelskega povračila za pokol v Münchnu na poletnih olimpijskih igrah leta 1972.

Izraelski vojaki so na libanonske plaže prispeli z gliserji, spuščenimi z raketnih čolnov na odprtem morju. Agenti Mosada so jih na plažah pričakali z avtomobili, najetimi prejšnji dan, jih odpeljali do ciljev in pozneje nazaj na plaže, od koder so se umaknili.
Med operacijo so bili ubiti trije najvišji voditelji PLO, ki so jih presenetili doma, in drugi člani PLO. Umrlo je tudi več libanonskih varnostnikov in civilnih sosedov ter dva izraelska vojaka.

source.title: 1973 Israeli raid in Lebanon
paragraphs: On the night of April 9 and early morning of April 10, 1973, Israel Defense Forces special forces units attacked several Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) targets in Beirut and Sidon, Lebanon. The attack, known as Operation Spring of Youth, is generally considered to have been part of Operation Wrath of God, Israel's retaliation for the Munich massacre at the 1972 Summer Olympics.

The Israeli troops arrived at the Lebanese beaches on speedboats launched from missile boats offshore. Mossad agents awaited the forces on the beaches with cars rented the previous day, and then drove them to their targets and later back to the beaches for extraction.

During the operation, three of the highest-level PLO leaders, surprised at home, were killed, along with other PLO members. Several Lebanese security people and civilian neighbors were also killed, as were two of the Israeli soldiers.

1975 Algiers Agreement.headline: Alžirski sporazum leta 1975
paragraphs: Alžirski sporazum leta 1975, znan tudi kot alžirski sporazumi ali alžirska deklaracija, sta podpisala Iran in Irak, da bi rešila vse odprte ozemeljske spore ob iransko-iraški meji. Posredovala je Alžirija, sporazum pa je bil podlaga za nadaljnji dvostranski pogodbi, podpisani 13. junija 1975 in 26. decembra 1975. Ozemeljski spori so zadevali iraški Šat al Arab in iransko provinco Huzestan; Irak se je hotel pogajati, da bi končal iransko podporo tedanjemu kurdskemu uporu v Iraku, potem ko je bil v spopadu za Šat al Arab v letih 1974–1975 vojaško poražen. Iraška vlada je pogodbo 17. septembra 1980, kmalu po iranski revoluciji, zaradi nove vrste obmejnih spopadov med državama razveljavila. Z iraško invazijo na Iran 22. septembra 1980, ki je sprožila osemletno iransko-iraško vojno, je pogodba povsem prenehala veljati.

source.title: 1975 Algiers Agreement
paragraphs: The 1975 Algiers Agreement, also known as the Algiers Accords and the Algiers Declaration, was signed between Iran and Iraq to settle any outstanding territorial disputes along the Iran–Iraq border. Mediated by Algeria, it served as the basis for additional bilateral treaties signed on 13 June 1975 and 26 December 1975. The territorial disputes in question concerned Iraq's Shatt al-Arab and Iran's Khuzestan Province, and Iraq had wished to negotiate to end Iran's support for the then-ongoing Iraqi Kurdish rebellion after suffering a military defeat in the 1974–1975 Shatt al-Arab conflict. On 17 September 1980, shortly after the Iranian Revolution, the Iraqi government abrogated the treaty in light of another series of cross-border clashes between the two countries. On 22 September 1980, the treaty was completely voided with the Iraqi invasion of Iran, which triggered the eight-year-long Iran–Iraq War.

Južnolibanonski konflikt leta 1978, znan tudi kot prva izraelska invazija na Libanon, z izraelskim kodnim imenom operacija Litani, se je začel, ko je Izrael marca 1978 vdrl v južni Libanon do reke Litani. To je bil odgovor na pokol na obalni cesti pri Tel Avivu, ki so ga zagrešili palestinski borci s sedežem v Libanonu. V spopadu je umrlo od 1100 do 2000 Libanoncev in Palestincev ter 20 Izraelcev, od 100.000 do 250.000 ljudi pa je bilo v Libanonu notranje razseljenih. Izraelske obrambne sile so vojaško zmagale nad Palestinsko osvobodilno organizacijo (PLO), ki se je morala umakniti iz južnega Libanona, kar ji je onemogočilo napade na Izrael čez kopensko mejo z Libanonom. Varnostni svet Združenih narodov je po izbruhu sovražnosti 19. marca 1978 sprejel resoluciji 425 in 426, ki sta Izrael pozvali k takojšnjemu umiku čet iz Libanona in ustanovili začasne sile Združenih narodov v Libanonu (UNIFIL).
Izrael je leta 1982 drugič vdrl v Libanon.

source.title: 1978 South Lebanon conflict
paragraphs: The 1978 South Lebanon conflict, also known as the First Israeli invasion of Lebanon and codenamed Operation Litani by Israel, began when Israel invaded southern Lebanon up to the Litani River in March 1978. It was in response to the Coastal Road massacre near Tel Aviv by Palestinian militants based in Lebanon. The conflict resulted in the deaths of 1,100–2,000 Lebanese and Palestinians, 20 Israelis, and the internal displacement of 100,000 to 250,000 people in Lebanon. The Israel Defense Forces gained a military victory against the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) as the latter was forced to withdraw from southern Lebanon, preventing it from launching attacks on Israel from across its land border with Lebanon. In response to the outbreak of hostilities, the United Nations Security Council adopted Resolution 425 and Resolution 426 on 19 March 1978, which called on Israel to immediately withdraw its troops from Lebanon and established the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon (UNIFIL).
Israel launched a second invasion of Lebanon in 1982.

Libanonska vojna leta 1982, imenovana tudi druga izraelska invazija na Libanon, se je začela 6. junija 1982, ko je Izrael vdrl v južni Libanon. Invaziji je sledila vrsta napadov in protinapadov med Palestinsko osvobodilno organizacijo (PLO), ki je delovala v južnem Libanonu, in izraelskimi obrambnimi silami (IDF), ki so zahtevali civilne žrtve na obeh straneh meje. Izraelska vojaška operacija s kodnim imenom Mir za Galilejo se je začela, potem ko so oboroženci Organizacije Abu Nidal poskušali umoriti Šloma Argova, izraelskega veleposlanika v Združenem kraljestvu. Izraelski premier Menahem Begin je za napad okrivil PLO in ga uporabil kot casus belli. Bila je druga izraelska invazija na Libanon, za južnolibanonskim konfliktom leta 1978.

source.title: 1982 Lebanon War
paragraphs: The 1982 Lebanon War, also called the Second Israeli invasion of Lebanon, began on 6 June 1982, when Israel invaded southern Lebanon. The invasion followed a series of attacks and counter-attacks between the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) operating in southern Lebanon and the Israel Defense Forces (IDF), which had caused civilian casualties on both sides of the border. The Israeli military operation, codenamed Operation Peace for Galilee, was launched after gunmen from the Abu Nidal Organization attempted to assassinate Shlomo Argov, Israel's ambassador to the United Kingdom. Israeli prime minister Menachem Begin blamed the PLO, using the incident as a casus belli. It was the second invasion of Lebanon by Israel, following the 1978 South Lebanon conflict.

Iraške vstaje leta 1991 so bile etnične in verske vstaje proti baatističnemu režimu Sadama Huseina, ki so jih vodili predvsem šiitski uporniki in Kurdi. Trajale so od marca do aprila 1991, po premirju ob koncu zalivske vojne. Večinoma neusklajeni upor je spodbujal vtis, da je iraški predsednik Sadam Husein postal ranljiv in da je zamenjava režima mogoča. Ta vtis šibkosti je bil v veliki meri posledica izida iransko-iraške in zalivske vojne, ki sta se zvrstili v enem samem desetletju in opustošili prebivalstvo in gospodarstvo Iraka.

source.title: 1991 Iraqi uprisings
paragraphs: The 1991 Iraqi uprisings were ethnic and religious uprisings against Saddam Hussein's Ba'athist regime that were mainly led by Shia rebels and Kurds. The uprisings lasted from March to April 1991 after a ceasefire following the end of the Gulf War. The mostly uncoordinated insurgency was fueled by the perception that Iraqi President Saddam Hussein had become vulnerable to regime change. This perception of weakness was largely the result of the outcome of the Iran–Iraq War and the Gulf War, both of which occurred within a single decade and devastated the population and economy of Iraq.

Invazija na Irak leta 2003 je bila prva faza iraške vojne. Začela se je 20. marca 2003 in trajala nekaj več kot mesec dni, od tega 26 dni velikih bojnih operacij. Izvedla jo je koalicija pod vodstvom Združenih držav, ki so jo sestavljali predvsem ameriški, britanski, avstralski in poljski vojaki.

Po besedah ameriškega predsednika Georgea W. Busha in britanskega premiera Tonyja Blaira je koalicija hotela Irak razorožiti orožja za množično uničevanje – jedrskega, kemičnega in biološkega – in »osvoboditi iraško ljudstvo« z odstavitvijo predsednika Sadama Huseina ter s tem končati njegovo »podporo terorizmu«. Inšpektorji Združenih narodov (OZN) pred invazijo v Iraku niso našli nobenih dokazov o iraškem orožju za množično uničevanje; ameriški in britanski uradniki so trdili, da je še vedno skrito in da neposredno ogroža svetovni mir.

source.title: 2003 invasion of Iraq
paragraphs: The 2003 invasion of Iraq was the first stage of the Iraq War. The invasion began on 20 March 2003 and lasted just over one month, including 26 days of major combat operations. The invasion was conducted by a United States–led coalition of mainly American, British, Australian, and Polish troops.

According to US president George W. Bush and UK prime minister Tony Blair, the coalition aimed to disarm Iraq of weapons of mass destruction (WMDs)—nuclear, chemical, and biological weapons—and "free the Iraqi people" by deposing president Saddam Hussein, in turn ending his "support for terrorism". Before the invasion, United Nations (UN) inspectors in Iraq had found no evidence of Iraqi WMDs; US and British officials claimed they were still hidden, and posed an immediate threat to world peace.

Libanonska vojna leta 2006 je bil 34-dnevni oboroženi spopad v Libanonu med Hezbolahom in Izraelom. Začela se je 12. julija 2006 in trajala, dokler ni zjutraj 14. avgusta 2006 začelo veljati premirje, ki so ga posredovali Združeni narodi; formalno se je končala 8. septembra 2006, ko je Izrael odpravil pomorsko blokado Libanona. Bila je tretja izraelska invazija na Libanon po letu 1978.

source.title: 2006 Lebanon War
paragraphs: The 2006 Lebanon War was a 34-day armed conflict in Lebanon, fought between Hezbollah and Israel. The war started on 12 July 2006 and continued until a United Nations-brokered ceasefire went into effect in the morning on 14 August 2006, though it formally ended on 8 September 2006 when Israel lifted its naval blockade of Lebanon. It marked the third Israeli invasion into Lebanon since 1978.

2011 Bahraini uprising.headline: Vstaja v Bahrajnu leta 2011
paragraphs: Bahrajnska vstaja leta 2011 je bila vrsta protivladnih protestov v Bahrajnu, ki jih je od leta 2011 do 2014 vodila večinoma šiitska bahrajnska opozicija z nekaj pripadniki sunitske manjšine. Proteste so navdihnili nemiri arabske pomladi leta 2011 ter protesti v Tuniziji in Egiptu, v vsakodnevne spopade pa so prerasli, ko je bahrajnska vlada upor zatrla s pomočjo sil Ščit polotoka Sveta za sodelovanje v Zalivu. Bahrajnski protesti so bili vrsta demonstracij, ki so prerasle v dolgotrajno kampanjo nenasilne državljanske nepokorščine in deloma nasilnega odpora v državi ob Perzijskem zalivu. Kot del revolucionarnega vala protestov na Bližnjem vzhodu in v severni Afriki, ki je sledil samosežigu Mohameda Buazizija v Tuniziji, so bili sprva namenjeni večji politični svobodi in enakopravnosti za šiitsko prebivalstvo, ki obsega 70 % prebivalcev.

source.title: 2011 Bahraini uprising
paragraphs: The 2011 Bahraini uprising was a series of anti-government protests in Bahrain led by the Shia-dominant and some Sunni minority Bahraini opposition from 2011 until 2014. The protests were inspired by the unrest of the 2011 Arab Spring and protests in Tunisia and Egypt and escalated to daily clashes after the Bahraini government repressed the revolt with the support of the Gulf Cooperation Council's Peninsula Shield Force. The Bahraini protests were a series of demonstrations, amounting to a sustained campaign of non-violent civil disobedience and some violent resistance in the Persian Gulf country of Bahrain. As part of the revolutionary wave of protests in the Middle East and North Africa following the self-immolation of Mohamed Bouazizi in Tunisia, the Bahraini protests were initially aimed at achieving greater political freedom and equality for the 70% Shia population.

2011 southern Israel cross-border attack.headline: Napadi na jugu Izraela leta 2011
paragraphs: Skupina domnevno dvanajstih borcev v štirih skupinah je 18. avgusta 2011 na jugu Izraela, na cesti 12 blizu egiptovske meje, izvedla vrsto čezmejnih napadov, ki so potekali vzporedno in so se medsebojno krili. Napadi so se zgodili, potem ko je izraelska notranja varnostna služba Šin Bet opozorila na napad borcev v pokrajini in so na območje napotili izraelske vojake. Borci so najprej streljali na avtobus družbe Egged številka 392, ki je vozil po cesti 12 v Negevu blizu Ejlata. Nekaj minut pozneje je ob izraelski vojaški patrulji na meji z Egiptom eksplodirala bomba. V tretjem napadu je protitankovski izstrelek zadel zasebno vozilo in ubil štiri civiliste. V večstopenjskem napadu je umrlo osem Izraelcev – šest civilistov, policijski ostrostrelec posebne enote Jamam in vojak brigade Golani. Izraelske obrambne sile so sporočile, da so ubile osem napadalcev, egiptovske varnostne sile pa še dva.

source.title: 2011 southern Israel cross-border attacks
paragraphs: On August 18, 2011, a series of cross-border attacks with parallel attacks and mutual cover was carried out in southern Israel on Highway 12 near the Egyptian border by a squad of presumably twelve militants in four groups. The attacks occurred after Israel's interior security service Shin Bet had warned of an attack by militants in the region and Israeli troops had been stationed in the area. The militants first opened fire at an Egged No. 392 bus as it was traveling on Highway 12 in the Negev near Eilat. Several minutes later, a bomb was detonated next to an Israeli army patrol along Israel's border with Egypt. In a third attack, an anti-tank missile hit a private vehicle, killing four civilians. Eight Israelis – six civilians, one Yamam special unit police sniper and one Golani Brigade soldier—were killed in the multiple-stage attack. The Israel Defense Forces reported eight attackers killed, and Egyptian security forces reported killing another two.

Med Izraelom in Hezbolahom je med bližnjevzhodno krizo leta 2024 v Libanonu potekala vojna. Začela se je septembra 2024, po skoraj 12 mesecih spopadov med njima, ko je Izrael začel velike napade v Libanonu, med drugim napad na pozivnike in elektronske naprave, umor voditelja Hezbolaha Hasana Nasralaha in letalsko bombardiranje po vsej državi. Vojna se je zaostrila 1. oktobra, ko je Izrael prestopil modro črto in šestič po letu 1978 vdrl v Libanon. Izrael in Libanon sta 26. novembra podpisala sporazum o premirju, ki sta ga posredovali Francija in Združene države. Premirje je začelo veljati 27. novembra, čeprav so se nekateri napadi v okviru širšega spopada nadaljevali.

source.title: 2024 Lebanon war
paragraphs: A war between Israel and Hezbollah took place in Lebanon during 2024 amid the Middle Eastern crisis. The war began in September 2024 following nearly 12 months of conflict between Israel and Hezbollah, when the former initiated major attacks in Lebanon including an attack on pagers and electronic devices, the assassination of Hezbollah leader Hassan Nasrallah, and an aerial bombing campaign throughout the country. The war escalated on 1 October, when Israel crossed the Blue Line in its sixth invasion of Lebanon since 1978. On 26 November, Israel and Lebanon signed a ceasefire agreement, mediated by France and the United States. The ceasefire went into effect on 27 November, though some attacks continued as part of the broader conflict.

Aden Emergency.headline: Izredne razmere v Adnu
paragraphs: Izredne razmere v Adnu, znane tudi kot revolucija 14. oktobra ali upor v Adnu, so bile oborožen upor, ki sta ga vodili predvsem Narodnoosvobodilna fronta (NLF) in Fronta za osvoboditev zasedenega Južnega Jemna (FLOSY) proti britanskemu protektoratu in Federaciji Južne Arabije. Začel se je 14. oktobra 1963, ko so plemena iz Radfana napadla britanske vojake, končal pa se je z razglasitvijo neodvisnosti Ljudske republike Južni Jemen.

Britanci so izredne razmere razglasili, potem ko je 10. decembra 1963 v letalskem oporišču RAF Khormaksar nekdo vrgel granato med zbrane britanske uradnike. Izredne razmere so nato razglasili v britanski kronski koloniji Aden in njenem zaledju, protektoratu Aden. Leta 1967 so se razmere zaostrile, kar je pospešilo konec britanske oblasti na tem ozemlju, ki se je začela leta 1839.

source.title: Aden Emergency
paragraphs: The Aden Emergency, also known as the 14 October Revolution or the Aden Insurgency, was an armed rebellion led mainly by the National Liberation Front (NLF) and the Front for the Liberation of Occupied South Yemen (FLOSY) against the British Protectorate and Federation of South Arabia. It began on 14 October 1963 when tribes from Radfan attacked British troops and ended with the proclamation of independence of the People's Republic of Southern Yemen.

The British had declared a state of emergency following the throwing of a grenade at a gathering of British officials on 10 December 1963 at RAF Khormaksar. A state of emergency was then declared in the British Crown colony of Aden and its hinterland, the Aden Protectorate. The emergency escalated in 1967, which hastened the end of British rule in the territory, which had begun in 1839.

Aden Revolt.headline: Upor v Adnu leta 1548
paragraphs: Upor v Adnu leta 1548 je bil upor proti osmanski oblasti v Jemnu, ki so ga zatrli, ko so 26. februarja 1548 prispele osmanske sile pod vodstvom Pirija Reisa.

source.title: Aden Revolt
paragraphs: The Aden revolt of 1548 was a rebellion against Ottoman rule in Yemen, that was suppressed after Ottoman forces under Piri Reis arrived on 26 February 1548.

Zavarovane dežele Irana, splošno znane kot afšaridski Iran, afšaridska Perzija ali Afšaridski imperij, so bile iranski imperij, ki ga je ustanovilo turkmensko pleme Afšar v severovzhodni iranski provinci Horasan; dinastija Afšaridov je Iranu vladala sredi 18. stoletja. Njen ustanovitelj Nader šah je bil uspešen vojskovodja, ki je leta 1736 odstavil zadnjega pripadnika dinastije Safavidov in se razglasil za šaha.

Pod Nader šahom je Iran dosegel največji obseg od časov Sasanidskega imperija. Na vrhuncu je vladal današnjemu Iranu, Kavkazu, Afganistanu, Uzbekistanu in drugim delom Srednje Azije ter delom Arabije, indijske podceline, Iraka in Turčije. Po njegovi smrti so si večino imperija razdelili Zandi, Durani in Kalatski kanat, oblast Afšaridov pa se je skrčila na majhno krajevno državo v Horasanu. Dinastijo je leta 1796 dokončno strmoglavil Aga Mohamed kan Kadžar, ki je ustanovil Kadžarski imperij in znova vzpostavil iransko nadoblast nad prej izgubljenimi območji.

source.title: Afsharid Iran
paragraphs: The Guarded Domains of Iran, commonly referred to as Afsharid Iran, Afsharid Persia or the Afsharid Empire, was an Iranian empire established by the Turkoman Afshar tribe in Iran's north-eastern province of Khorasan, the Afsharid dynasty would rule over Iran during the mid 18th century. The dynasty's founder, Nader Shah, was a successful military commander who deposed the last member of the Safavid dynasty in 1736, and proclaimed himself Shah.

During Nader Shah's reign, Iran reached its greatest extent since the time of the Sasanian Empire. At its height it ruled modern-day Iran, the Caucasus, Afghanistan, Uzbekistan and other parts of Central Asia, as well as parts of Arabia, the Indian subcontinent, Iraq and Turkey. After his death, most of his empire was divided between the Zands, Durranis, and Khanate of Kalat, with Afsharid rule being confined to a small local state in Khorasan. The Afsharid dynasty was finally overthrown in 1796 by Agha Mohammad Khan Qajar, who founded the Qajar Empire and reestablished Iranian suzerainty over the previously lost regions.

Oaza Al Ahsa (arabsko: al-Ahsā), znana tudi kot al Hasa ali Hadžar, je oaza in zgodovinska pokrajina na vzhodu Savdske Arabije. Po njej se imenuje guvernorat Al Ahsa, ki obsega velik del Vzhodne province države. Oaza leži okoli 60 km v notranjosti od obale Perzijskega zaliva in jo sestavljajo štiri glavna mesta in 22 vasi. Med mesti sta Al Mubaraz in Al Hufuf, dve največji mesti v Savdski Arabiji.

source.title: Al-Ahsa Oasis
paragraphs: Al-Ahsa Oasis (Arabic: الْأَحْسَاء, al-ʾAhsā), also known as al-Ḥasāʾ (الْحَسَا) or Hajar (هَجَر), is an oasis and historical region in eastern Saudi Arabia. Al-Ahsa Governorate, which makes up much of the country's Eastern Province, is named after it. The oasis is located about 60 km (37 miles) inland from the coast of the Persian Gulf. Al-Ahsa Oasis comprises four main cities and 22 villages. The cities include Al-Mubarraz and Al-Hofuf, two of the largest cities in Saudi Arabia.

Alid dynasties of northern Iran.headline: Alidske dinastije severnega Irana
paragraphs: Alidske dinastije severnega Irana ali Alavidi (perzijsko: علویان طبرستان). V 9. in 10. stoletju so severnoiranske pokrajine Tabaristan, Dajlam in Gilan, stisnjene med Kaspijsko jezero in gorovje Alborz, prišle pod oblast več alidskih dinastij, privrženk zajdijske veje šiitskega islama.
Prvi in najmogočnejši zajdijski emirat so ustanovili v Tabaristanu leta 864 in je trajal do leta 928. Leta 900 ga je prekinila samanidska zasedba, leta 914 pa ga je obnovila druga alidska veja.

Drugo obdobje alidskega emirata so pestili notranji spori in boji za oblast med vejama, končalo pa se je leta 928 z drugo samanidsko osvojitvijo pokrajine. Nekateri alavidski vojaki in generali so nato prestopili k Samanidom, med njimi Mardavidž, ustanovitelj dinastije Zijaridov, in trije Bujini sinovi (Ali, Hasan in Ahmad), ustanovitelji dinastije Bujidov.

source.title: Alid dynasties of northern Iran
paragraphs: Alid dynasties of northern Iran or Alavids (Persian: علویان طبرستان). In the 9th–10th centuries, the northern Iranian regions of Tabaristan, Daylam and Gilan, sandwiched between the Caspian Sea and the Alborz range, came under the rule of a number of Alid dynasties, espousing the Zaydi branch of Shia Islam.
The first and most powerful Zaydi emirate was established in Tabaristan in 864 and lasted until 928. It was interrupted by Samanid occupation in 900, but restored in 914 by another Alid branch.

The second period of the Alid emirate was plagued by internal dissensions and power struggles between the two branches, and ended in the second conquest of the region by the Samanids in 928. Subsequently, some of the soldiers and generals of the Alavids joined the Samanids, among them Mardavij, founder of the Ziyarid dynasty, and the three sons of Buya (Ali, Hassan and Ahmad), founders of the Buyid dynasty.

Alid revolt of 762–763.headline: Alidski upor v letih 762–763
paragraphs: Alidski upor v letih 762–763 ali upor Mohameda Čiste duše je bila vstaja hasanidske veje Alidov proti novoustanovljenemu Abasidskemu kalifatu. Hasanidi pod vodstvom bratov Mohameda (imenovanega »Čista duša«) in Ibrahima niso priznavali zakonitosti abasidske zahteve po oblasti. Ko jih je abasidski režim vse bolj preganjal, so leta 762 sprožili upor: Mohamed se je septembra uprl v Medini, Ibrahim pa mu je novembra sledil v Basri.

source.title: Alid revolt of 762–763
paragraphs: The Alid revolt of 762–763 or Revolt of Muhammad the Pure Soul was an uprising by the Hasanid branch of the Alids against the newly established Abbasid Caliphate. The Hasanids, led by the brothers Muhammad (called "the Pure Soul") and Ibrahim, rejected the legitimacy of the Abbasid family's claim to power. Reacting to mounting persecution by the Abbasid regime, in 762 they launched a rebellion, with Muhammad rising in revolt at Medina in September and Ibrahim following in Basra in November.

Anbar campaign (2003–2011).headline: Kampanja v Anbarju (2003–2011)
paragraphs: Kampanjo v Anbarju so sestavljali boji med vojsko Združenih držav skupaj z iraškimi varnostnimi silami in sunitskimi uporniki v zahodnem iraškem guvernoratu Al Anbar. Iraška vojna je trajala od leta 2003 do 2011, večina bojev in protiuporniške kampanje v Anbarju pa je potekala med aprilom 2004 in septembrom 2007. Sprva so med uporniki in ameriškimi marinci potekali predvsem hudi ulični boji, v poznejših letih pa so se uporniki osredotočili na zasede ameriškim in iraškim varnostnim silam z improviziranimi eksplozivnimi napravami, obsežne napade na bojne postojanke in avtomobile bombe. V kampanji je umrlo skoraj 9000 Iračanov in 1335 Američanov, mnogi v dolini Evfrata in v sunitskem trikotniku okoli mest Faludža in Ramadi.

source.title: Anbar campaign (2003–2011)
paragraphs: The Anbar campaign consisted of fighting between the United States military, together with Iraqi security forces, and Sunni insurgents in the western Iraqi governorate of Al Anbar. The Iraq War lasted from 2003 to 2011, but the majority of the fighting and counterinsurgency campaign in Anbar took place between April 2004 and September 2007. Although the fighting initially featured heavy urban warfare primarily between insurgents and U.S. Marines, insurgents in later years focused on ambushing the American and Iraqi security forces with improvised explosive devices (IEDs), large scale attacks on combat outposts, and car bombings. Almost 9,000 Iraqis and 1,335 Americans were killed in the campaign, many in the Euphrates River Valley and the Sunni Triangle around the cities of Fallujah and Ramadi.

Suniti v Iraku so od decembra 2012 protestirali proti Malikijevi vladi. Sunitskega poslanca Ahmeda al Alvanija, vidnega podpornika protivladnih protestov, so 28. decembra 2013 aretirali v racijah na njegov dom v Ramadiju. Incident je v guvernoratu Al Anbar sprožil nasilje med iraško vojsko in ohlapnim zavezništvom plemenskih milic in drugih skupin, ki so se bojevale ob strani Islamske države Iraka in Levanta (ISIL).

Januarja 2014 so protivladne sile zavzele Faludžo, v Ramadiju pa so potekali hudi boji. Marca je iraška vojska zavarovala Ramadi in skušala znova zavzeti Faludžo. Junija je ISIL skupaj z napadom na severni Irak začel veliko ofenzivo v Anbarju in do 23. junija nadzoroval najmanj 70 % province.

source.title: Anbar campaign (2013–2014)
paragraphs: Beginning in December 2012, Sunnis in Iraq protested against the Maliki government. On 28 December 2013, a Sunni MP named Ahmed al-Alwani was arrested in a raid on his home in Ramadi. Alwani was a prominent supporter of the anti-government protests. This incident led to violence in Al Anbar Governorate between the Iraqi Army and a loose alliance of tribal militias and other groups fighting alongside the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL).

In January 2014, the anti-government forces took control of Fallujah, and there was heavy fighting in Ramadi. In March, the Iraqi army secured Ramadi and attempted to regain Fallujah. In June, ISIL launched a major offensive in Anbar in conjunction with their assault on northern Iraq. By 23 June, they controlled at least 70% of Anbar.

Anfal campaign.headline: Kampanja Anfal
paragraphs: Kampanja Anfal je bila protiuporniška operacija, ki jo mnogi raziskovalci in organizacije za človekove pravice označujejo za genocid ali etnično čiščenje; izvajal jo je baatistični Irak od februarja do septembra 1988 med iraško-kurdskim spopadom ob koncu iransko-iraške vojne. Uperjena je bila proti podeželskim Kurdom, saj je hotela odpraviti kurdske uporniške skupine in arabizirati strateške dele guvernorata Kirkuk. Baatistični režim je nad krajevnim kurdskim prebivalstvom, večinoma civilisti, zagrešil grozodejstva. Glavna tarča so bili Kurdi, žrtve kampanje pa so postale tudi druge manjšine na severu, kot so Asirci in Turkmeni.
Iraške sile je po ukazu predsednika Sadama Huseina vodil Ali Hasan al Madžid. Ime kampanje izvira iz naslova osme sure Korana (al ʾanfāl).

source.title: Anfal campaign
paragraphs: The Anfal campaign, was a counterinsurgency operation, described by many scholars and human rights groups as a genocide or ethnic cleansing, which was carried out by Ba'athist Iraq from February to September 1988 during the Iraqi–Kurdish conflict at the end of the Iran–Iraq War. The campaign targeted rural Kurds because its purpose was to eliminate Kurdish rebel groups and Arabize strategic parts of the Kirkuk Governorate. The Ba'athist regime committed atrocities on the local Kurdish population, mostly civilians. While the primary targets were Kurds, other minorities in the north such as Assyrians and Turkmen also fell victim to the Anfal campaign.
The Iraqi forces were led by Ali Hassan al-Majid, on the orders of President Saddam Hussein. The campaign's name was taken from the title of the eighth chapter of the Qur'an (al-ʾanfāl).

Angleško-iraška vojna je bil zavezniški vojaški pohod pod britanskim vodstvom med drugo svetovno vojno proti Kraljevini Irak, ki ji je tedaj vladal Rašid Ali al Gajlani; ta je z nemško in italijansko pomočjo prevzel oblast v iraškem državnem udaru leta 1941. Pohod je strmoglavil Gajlanijevo vlado, Britanci so Irak znova zasedli, na oblast pa se je vrnil iraški regent, princ Abd al Ilah, britanski zaveznik.

source.title: Anglo-Iraqi War
paragraphs: The Anglo-Iraqi War was a British-led Allied military campaign during the Second World War against the Kingdom of Iraq, then ruled by Rashid Ali al-Gaylani who had seized power in the 1941 Iraqi coup d'état with assistance from Germany and Italy. The campaign resulted in the downfall of Gaylani's government, the re-occupation of Iraq by the British, and the return to power of the Regent of Iraq, Prince 'Abd al-Ilah, a British ally.

Antony's Atropatene campaign.headline: Antonijev pohod v Atropateno
paragraphs: Antonijev pohod v Atropateno, znan tudi kot Antonijev partski pohod, je bil vojaški pohod Marka Antonija, vzhodnega triumvira Rimske republike, proti Partskemu imperiju pod Fraatom IV.

Julij Cezar je načrtoval vdor v Partijo, a je umrl, preden ga je lahko izvedel. Leta 40 pr. n. št. so se Partom pridružile Pompejeve sile in za kratek čas zavzele velik del rimskega vzhoda, a jih je vojska, ki jo je poslal Antonij, porazila in jim odvzela pridobljeno.

Antonij se je povezal z več kraljestvi, med njimi z Armenijo, in leta 36 pr. n. št. z ogromno vojsko začel pohod proti Partiji. Ker se je evfratska fronta izkazala za močno, je izbral pot prek Armenije. Ko je vstopil v Atropateno, je partska konjenica uničila rimsko prtljago in oblegovalne stroje, ki so potovali po drugi poti. Antonij je pot nadaljeval in oblegal prestolnico Atropatene, a brez uspeha. Naporni umik v Armenijo in nato v Sirijo je njegovi vojski prizadejal nove izgube, zato je bila vojna za Rimljane taktična katastrofa in strateški neuspeh. Mir je pozneje izpogajal Avgust.

source.title: Antony's Atropatene campaign
paragraphs: Antony's Atropatene campaign, also known as Antony's Parthian campaign, was a military campaign by Mark Antony, the eastern triumvir of the Roman Republic, against the Parthian Empire under Phraates IV.

Julius Caesar had planned an invasion of Parthia but died before he could implement it. In 40 BC, the Parthians were joined by Pompeian forces and briefly captured much of the Roman East, but a force sent by Antony defeated them and reversed their gains.

Allying with several kingdoms, including Armenia, Antony began a campaign against Parthia with a massive force in 36 BC. Since the Euphrates front was found to be strong, Antony chose the route via Armenia. Upon entering Atropatene, the Roman baggage train and siege engines, which had taken a different route, were destroyed by a Parthian cavalry force. Antony moved on and besieged the Atropatene capital but was unsuccessful. The arduous journey of retreat to Armenia and then Syria further inflicted losses on his force, making the war a tactical Roman disaster and a strategic failure. Peace was later negotiated by Augustus.

Hašemitska arabska federacija je bila kratkotrajna konfederacija hašemitskih kraljevin Irak in Jordanija, ki je trajala od 14. februarja do 2. avgusta 1958. Čeprav ime nakazuje zvezno ureditev, je bila dejansko konfederacija.

Federacijo sta 14. februarja 1958 ustanovila iraški kralj Fejsal II. in njegov bratranec, jordanski kralj Husein, ki sta hotela kraljevini združiti v odgovor na nastanek Združene arabske republike Egipta in Sirije. Zveza je trajala le šest mesecev: Fejsala II. je 14. julija odstavil vojaški udar, nova iraška vlada pa je federacijo 2. avgusta 1958 uradno razpustila.

source.title: Arab Federation
paragraphs: The Hashemite Arab Federation was a short-lived confederation that lasted from 14 February to 2 August 1958, between the Hashemite kingdoms of Iraq and Jordan. Although the name implies a federal structure, it was de facto a confederation.

The Federation was formed on 14 February 1958, when King Faisal II of Iraq and his cousin, King Hussein of Jordan, sought to unite their two Hashemite kingdoms as a response to the formation of the United Arab Republic between Egypt and Syria. The union lasted only six months. Faisal II was deposed by a military coup on 14 July, and the new Iraqi government officially dissolved the Federation on 2 August 1958.

Arabski Irak (arabsko: ‘Irāq ul-‘Arab, dobesedno »Irak Arabcev«) je bil zgodovinski zemljepisni izraz, s katerim so srednjeveški in zgodnjenovoveški pisci označevali pokrajino Irak v Mezopotamiji, pogosto s središčem v spodnji Mezopotamiji. Njegov natančni obseg se je razlikoval glede na pisca in obdobje, nekateri viri pa ga opisujejo kot ozemlje, ki se v grobem ujema z velikim delom današnjega Iraka.

Izraz »arabski Irak« (perzijsko: Irâq-e Arab) se je razširil v seldžuškem obdobju (11.–12. stoletje), da bi zgodovinsko pokrajino Mezopotamijo (pravi Irak) ločili od »perzijskega Iraka« (Irâq-e Ajam), pokrajine, ki so jo prej imenovali al Džibal in je bila povezana z zgodovinsko pokrajino Medijo. Perzijski in arabski Irak so skupaj pogosto imenovali »al Irakajn«, »oba Iraka«. Gorata ozemlja med njima, Kurdistan, Luristan in Bahtiari, so glede na vojaške razmere lahko pripadala enemu ali drugemu, a so ne glede na to pogosto ohranjala veliko samostojnost.

source.title: Arab Iraq
paragraphs: Arab Iraq or Arabian Iraq (Arabic: عراق العرب, romanized: ‘Irāq ul-‘Arab, lit. 'Iraq of the Arabs') was a historical geographical term used by medieval and early modern writers for the region of Iraq in Mesopotamia, often centered in Lower Mesopotamia. Its precise extent varied by author and period, and some sources describe Arab Iraq as corresponding roughly to much of modern Iraq.

The term "Arab Iraq" (Persian: عراق عرب, romanized: Irâq-e Arab) became commonly used in the Seljuk period (11th–12th centuries) as a way to distinguish the historical region of Mesopotamia (Iraq proper) from "Persian Iraq" (Persian: عراق عجم, romanized: Irâq-e Ajam), a region previously referred to as al-Jibal, associated with the historical region of Media. Persian Iraq and Arab Iraq were often referred to as "al-Iraqayn" (Arabic: العراقين) meaning "the two Iraqs" collectively. The mountainous territories between them, comprising Kurdistan, Luristan, and Bakhtiyari, could have fell under either region depending on the military situation, but often maintained a high degree of autonomy regardless.

Arabski upor (arabsko: al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya), znan tudi kot veliki arabski upor (al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya al-Kubrā), je bila oborožena vstaja Arabcev iz Hedžasa pod hašemitskim vodstvom proti Osmanskemu cesarstvu na bližnjevzhodnem bojišču prve svetovne vojne.

Na podlagi dopisovanja med Henryjem McMahonom iz Združenega kraljestva in Huseinom bin Alijem iz Kraljevine Hedžas se je upor proti vladajočim Turkom uradno začel 10. junija 1916 v Meki. Glavni cilj arabskih upornikov je bila neodvisna in enotna arabska država od Alepa do Adna, ki jo je britanska vlada obljubila priznati.

Šarifska vojska pod vodstvom Huseina in Hašemitov je ob podpori britanskih egiptovskih ekspedicijskih sil uspešno pregnala osmansko vojsko iz večjega dela Hedžasa in Transjordanije. Do leta 1918 so uporniki zavzeli Damask in razglasili Arabsko kraljestvo Sirija, kratkotrajno monarhijo, ki jo je vodil Huseinov sin Fejsal I.

source.title: Arab Revolt
paragraphs: The Arab Revolt (Arabic: الثورة العربية al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya), also known as the Great Arab Revolt (الثورة العربية الكبرى al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya al-Kubrā), was an armed uprising by the Hashemite-led Arabs of the Hejaz against the Ottoman Empire amidst the Middle Eastern theatre of World War I.

On the basis of the McMahon–Hussein Correspondence, exchanged between Henry McMahon of the United Kingdom and Hussein bin Ali of the Kingdom of Hejaz, the rebellion against the ruling Turks was officially initiated at Mecca on 10 June 1916. The primary goal of the Arab rebels was to establish an independent and unified Arab state stretching from Aleppo to Aden, which the British government had promised to recognize.

The Sharifian Army, led by Hussein and the Hashemites with backing from the British military's Egyptian Expeditionary Force, successfully fought and expelled the Ottoman military presence from much of the Hejaz and Transjordan. By 1918, the rebels had captured Damascus and proclaimed the Arab Kingdom of Syria, a short-lived monarchy that was led by Hussein's son Faisal I.

Arabska socialistična stranka Baath – regija Sirija (arabsko: Ḥizb al-Ba'th al-'Arabī al-Ishtirākī – Quṭr Sūriyā), uradno sirska regionalna veja, je bila baatistična organizacija, ki so jo 7. aprila 1947 ustanovili Michel Aflaq, Salah al Din al Bitar in privrženci Zakija al Arsuzija. Stranka je Sirijo vodila od državnega udara leta 1963, ki je baatiste pripeljal na oblast, do 8. decembra 2024, ko je Bašar al Asad pred uporniško ofenzivo, ki je končala sirsko državljansko vojno, pobegnil iz Damaska. Formalno so jo razpustili januarja 2025.

source.title: Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party – Syria Region
paragraphs: The Arab Socialist Ba'ath Party – Syria Region (Arabic: حزب البعث العربي الاشتراكي – قطر سوريا Ḥizb al-Ba'th al-'Arabī al-Ishtirākī – Quṭr Sūriyā), officially the Syrian Regional Branch (Arabic: الفرع القطري السوري), was a Ba'athist organisation founded on 7 April 1947 by Michel Aflaq, Salah al-Din al-Bitar and followers of Zaki al-Arsuzi. The party ruled Syria from the 1963 coup d'état, which brought the Ba'athists to power, until 8 December 2024, when Bashar al-Assad fled Damascus in the face of a rebel offensive which concluded the Syrian civil war. It was formally disbanded in January 2025.

Assassination of Uthman.headline: Umor kalifa Osmana
paragraphs: Osman ibn Afan, tretji pravoverni kalif, ki je vladal od leta 644 do 656, je bil leta 656 umorjen ob koncu obleganja svoje hiše. Sprva je šlo za protest, ki pa je po smrti enega od protestnikov prerasel v obleganje. Protestniki, ki so postali uporniki, so zahtevali novega kalifa, kar je Osman zavrnil. Protestniki so 17. junija 656 (35 po hidžri) hišo zažgali, vdrli vanjo in ga ubili.

Osmanov umor je tedanjo umo razklal. Odprl je vprašanja ne le o njegovem značaju in politiki, temveč tudi o odnosu med muslimani in državo, o verskih pogledih na upor in vladanje ter o pogojih za vladanje v islamu.

source.title: Assassination of Uthman
paragraphs: Uthman ibn Affan, the third Rashidun caliph, who ruled from 644 to 656, was assassinated at the end of a siege upon his house in 656. This was initially a protest but escalated into a siege following the death of a protester. The protesters-turned-rebels had demanded a new caliph, which Uthman refused. On 17 June 656 (35 AH) protestors set the house on fire, made their way inside, and killed him.

The assassination of Uthman had a polarizing effect on the Ummah at the time. Questions were raised not only regarding his character and policies but also the relationship between Muslims and the state, religious beliefs regarding rebellion and governance, and the qualifications of rulership in Islam.

Assyrian conquest of Egypt.headline: Asirska osvojitev Egipta
paragraphs: Asirska osvojitev Egipta je zajela razmeroma kratko obdobje Novoasirskega cesarstva, od leta 673 do 663 pr. n. št. Asirci si niso le podredili dežele z velikim kulturnim ugledom, temveč so z osvojitvijo Egipta cesarstvu dali tudi največji obseg.

source.title: Assyrian conquest of Egypt
paragraphs: The Assyrian conquest of Egypt covered a relatively short period of the Neo-Assyrian Empire from 673 to 663 BCE. The conquest of Egypt not only placed a land of great cultural prestige under Assyrian rule but also brought the Neo-Assyrian Empire to its greatest extent.

Asirsko obleganje Jeruzalema (ok. 701 pr. n. št.) je bilo prekinjeno obleganje Jeruzalema, tedanje prestolnice Kraljestva Juda, ki ga je izvedel Senaherib, kralj Novoasirskega cesarstva. Obleganje je sklenilo Senaheribov pohod v Levant, v katerem je v pohodu podjarmljanja napadal judovska utrjena mesta in pustošil podeželje. Senaherib je Jeruzalem oblegal, a ga ni zavzel.

Senaheribovi anali opisujejo, kako je kralj judovskega kralja Ezekija zaprl v Jeruzalem »kakor ptico v kletko« in se pozneje, ko je od Jude prejel davek, vrnil v Asirijo. Po hebrejski Bibliji je Ezekija Asiriji plačal 300 talentov srebra in 30 talentov zlata. Svetopisemska zgodba trdi, da je Senaherib z vojsko krenil nad Jeruzalem, a jo je pred mestnimi vrati pokončal angel, zato se je umaknil v Ninive.
Po teoriji svetopisemske arheologije je Ezekija v pripravah na grozeče obleganje zgradil predor Siloam in široki zid v Jeruzalemu.

source.title: Assyrian siege of Jerusalem
paragraphs: The Assyrian siege of Jerusalem (c. 701 BC) was an aborted siege of Jerusalem, then capital of the Kingdom of Judah, carried out by Sennacherib, king of the Neo-Assyrian Empire. The siege concluded Sennacharib's campaign in the Levant, in which he attacked the fortified cities and devastated the countryside of Judah in a campaign of subjugation. Sennacherib besieged Jerusalem, but did not capture it.

Sennacherib's Annals describe how the king trapped Hezekiah of Judah in Jerusalem "like a caged bird" and later returned to Assyria when he received tribute from Judah. In the Hebrew Bible, Hezekiah is described as paying 300 talents of silver and 30 talents of gold to Assyria. The biblical story claims that Sennacherib marched on Jerusalem with his army only to have it struck down near the gates of Jerusalem by an angel, prompting his retreat to Nineveh.
According to biblical archaeological theory, Siloam tunnel and the Broad Wall in Jerusalem were built by Hezekiah in preparation for the impending siege.

Basus War.headline: Vojna Basus
paragraphs: Vojna Basus (pogosto pisano vojna al Basus; arabsko: ḥarb al-basūs) je slavna pripoved o spopadu iz zbirke ajjām al-ʿarab (»dnevi Arabcev«), po izročilu datirana v pozno predislamsko Arabijo, ki prikazuje rivalstvo plemen Taglib in Bakr. Arabsko zgodovinsko in literarno izročilo jo opisuje kot štiridesetletno plemensko vojno, ki jo je sprožil uboj kamele, ki je pripadala ženski po imenu Basus. Zgodba ima pomembno mesto v arabski literarni kulturi kot slaven svarilni rek pred krvnim maščevanjem, nasiljem med sorodniki in stopnjevanjem spora.

source.title: Basus War
paragraphs: The Basus War (often written al-Basus War; Arabic: حرب البسوس ḥarb al-basūs) is a famous conflict narrative from the corpus of the ayyām al-ʿarab (Days of the Arabs), traditionally dated to late pre-Islamic Arabia and showcasing the rivalry of the tribes of Taghlib and Bakr. In Arabic historical and literary tradition, it is portrayed as a forty-year tribal war triggered by the killing of a camel belonging to a woman named Basus. The story occupies an important place in Arabic literary culture as a famous aphorism warning against vendetta, kin-violence, and escalation.

Battle for Jerusalem.headline: Bitka za Jeruzalem
paragraphs: Bitka za Jeruzalem je potekala v fazi državljanske vojne v letih 1947–1948, med palestinsko vojno v letih 1947–1949. Judovske in arabske milice v mandatni Palestini, pozneje pa vojski Izraela in Transjordanije, so se bojevale za nadzor nad Jeruzalemom. Po načrtu Združenih narodov za razdelitev Palestine iz leta 1947 naj bi bil Jeruzalem corpus separatum (»ločeno telo«), ki bi ga upravljal mednarodni organ. Kljub temu so v mestu takoj izbruhnili boji med judovskimi in arabskimi milicami, obe strani pa sta izvajali bombne in druge napade.

source.title: Battle for Jerusalem
paragraphs: The Battle for Jerusalem took place during the 1947–1948 civil war phase of the 1947–1949 Palestine war. It saw Jewish and Arab militias in Mandatory Palestine, and later the militaries of Israel and Transjordan, fight for control over the city of Jerusalem. Under the 1947 United Nations Partition Plan for Palestine, Jerusalem was to be a corpus separatum (lit. 'separated body') administered by an international body. Fighting nevertheless immediately broke out in the city between Jewish and Arab militias, with bombings and other attacks being carried out by both sides.

Battle of 73 Easting.headline: Bitka pri 73 Eastingu
paragraphs: Bitka pri 73 Eastingu je 26. februarja 1991, med zalivsko vojno, potekala med koalicijskimi oklepnimi silami (VII. korpus ZDA in britanska 1. oklepna divizija) in iraškimi oklepnimi silami (republikanska garda in divizija Tavakalna). Ime je dobila po koordinatni črti UTM v smeri sever–jug (»easting«, merjen v kilometrih in berljiv na sprejemnikih GPS), ki so jo koalicijske sile uporabljale kot črto faze za merjenje napredovanja po puščavi. Udeleženec bitke poročnik John Mecca jo je pozneje opisal kot »zadnjo veliko tankovsko bitko 20. stoletja«. Potekala je nekaj ur po drugi, manjši tankovski bitki pri Al Busajji.

source.title: Battle of 73 Easting
paragraphs: The Battle of 73 Easting was fought on 26 February 1991, during the Gulf War, between Coalition armored forces (US VII Corps and UK 1st Armoured Division) and Iraqi armored forces (Republican Guard and Tawakalna Division). It was named for a UTM north–south coordinate line (an "Easting", measured in kilometers and readable on GPS receivers) that was used as a phase line by Coalition forces to measure their progress through the desert. The battle was later described by Lt. John Mecca, a participant, as "the last great tank battle of the 20th century." This battle took place several hours after another, smaller, tank battle at Al Busayyah.

Battle of Ajnadayn.headline: Bitka pri Adžnadajnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Adžnadajnu (arabsko: معركة أجنادين) je potekala julija ali avgusta 634 (džumada I ali II leta 13 po hidžri) blizu kraja Bajt Džibrin; bila je prva velika bitka med Bizantinskim (Rimskim) cesarstvom in vojsko arabskega pravovernega kalifata. Končala se je z odločilno muslimansko zmago. Podrobnosti bitke so znane predvsem iz muslimanskih virov, kot je zgodovinar al Vakidi iz 9. stoletja.

source.title: Battle of Ajnadayn
paragraphs: The Battle of Ajnadayn (Arabic: معركة أجنادين) was fought in July or August 634 (Jumada I or II, 13 AH), in a location close to Bayt Jibrin; it was the first major pitched battle between the Byzantine (Roman) Empire and the army of the Arab Rashidun Caliphate. The result of the battle was a decisive Muslim victory. The details of this battle are mostly known through Muslim sources, such as the ninth-century historian al-Waqidi.

Battle of Al Faw (2003).headline: Bitka pri Al Favu (2003)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Al Favu se je začela 20. marca 2003 in je trajala štiri dni, v okviru invazije na Irak leta 2003.

Eden prvih ciljev koalicije je bil zavzeti vse plinske in naftne ploščadi (GOPLAT) na polotoku Al Fav, preden bi jih iraška vojska sabotirala ali uničila. S tem bi Iraku tudi preprečili, da bi povzročil novo ekološko katastrofo, kot jo je leta 1991 s požari kuvajtskih naftnih vrelcev in razlitjem nafte v Perzijskem zalivu. Z zavzetjem obale bi koalicija zagotovila tudi hitrejši prevzem iraške naftne proizvodnje.

Britanska 3. brigada komandosov naj bi hkrati zavzela Um Kasr, da bi pristanišče Um Kasr – edino globokovodno pristanišče v Iraku – lahko uporabili za dovoz težke vojaške opreme, ko bi skupina za protiminske ukrepe počistila Hor Abd Alah. 15. ekspedicijska enota ameriških marincev je bila podrejena 3. brigadi komandosov, da bi zagotovila sile, potrebne za zavzetje obeh ciljev.

source.title: Battle of Al Faw (2003)
paragraphs: The Battle of Al Faw began on 20 March 2003 and continued for four days, as part of the 2003 invasion of Iraq.

One of the initial objectives of the Coalition was to capture every GOPLAT (gas and oil platform) in the Al-Faw Peninsula before they could be sabotaged or destroyed by the Iraqi military. Doing so would also deny Iraq the ability to cause another ecological disaster, as it had done with the Kuwait oil fires and the Persian Gulf oil spill in 1991. By seizing the country's coast, the Coalition would also ensure a quicker takeover of Iraqi oil production.

The 3 Commando Brigade of the British Armed Forces would also capture Umm Qasr at the same time, so that Umm Qasr Port—the only deep water port in Iraq—could be used to bring in heavy military supplies once Khawr Abd Allah was cleared by the Mine Counter Measures Task Group. The 15th Marine Expeditionary Unit of the United States Marine Corps was placed under the command of the 3 Commando Brigade in order to provide the necessary force for capturing both targets.

Battle of al-Anbar.headline: Bitka pri Al Anbarju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Al Anbarju (arabsko: معركة الأنبار) je potekala med muslimansko arabsko vojsko pod poveljstvom Halida ibn al Valida in Sasanidskim imperijem. Bojevali so se pri Anbarju, ki leži približno 80 milj od starodavnega mesta Babilon. Halid je sasanidske Perzijce oblegal v mestni trdnjavi z močnim obzidjem, pri obleganju pa je sodelovalo veliko muslimanskih lokostrelcev. Perzijski guverner Širzad se je nazadnje vdal in smel oditi. Bitko se pogosto spominjajo kot »boj za oči«, saj so muslimanskim lokostrelcem naročili, naj merijo v »oči« perzijske posadke.

source.title: Battle of al-Anbar
paragraphs: The Battle of Al-Anbar (Arabic: معركة الأنبار) was between the Muslim Arab army under the command of Khalid ibn al-Walid and the Sasanian Empire. The battle took place at Anbar which is located approximately 80 miles from the ancient city of Babylon. Khalid besieged the Sassanian Persians in the city fortress, which had strong walls. Scores of Muslim archers were used in the siege. The Persian governor, Shirzad, eventually surrendered and was allowed to retire. The Battle of Al-Anbar is often remembered as the "Action of the Eye" since Muslim archers used in the battle were told to aim at the "eyes" of the Persian garrison.

Battle of al-Bab.headline: Bitka za Al Bab
paragraphs: Bitka za Al Bab je bila bitka za mesto Al Bab v guvernoratu Alep, ki je obsegala vojaško ofenzivo sirskih uporniških skupin (med njimi skupin, povezanih s Svobodno sirsko vojsko) in turških oboroženih sil severno od Al Baba, ločeno ofenzivo Sirskih demokratičnih sil (SDF) vzhodno in zahodno od mesta ter še ofenzivo sirske vojske z juga. Severne sile pod turškim vodstvom so hotele Al Bab v okviru turške vojaške intervencije v Siriji iztrgati Islamski državi Iraka in Levanta (ISIL). Do konca bitke so sile pod turškim vodstvom zavzele Al Bab, Kabasin in Bizaa, sirska vojska je zavzela Tadef in druga območja južneje, SDF pa je napredovala vzhodneje in zahodneje.

source.title: Battle of al-Bab
paragraphs: The Battle of al-Bab was a battle for the city of al-Bab in the Aleppo Governorate that included a military offensive launched by Syrian rebel groups (including groups affiliated with the Free Syrian Army) and the Turkish Armed Forces north of al-Bab, a separate Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) offensive east and west of the city, and another Syrian Army offensive from the south of the city. The northern Turkish-led forces intended to capture al-Bab from the Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant (ISIL), as part of the Turkish military intervention in Syria. By the end of the battle, the Turkish-led forces had captured al-Bab, Qabasin, and Bizaah, while the Syrian Army captured Tadef and other areas further south, with the SDF making gains further to the east and the west.

Battle of al-Buqaia.headline: Bitka pri Al Bukaji
paragraphs: V bitki pri Al Bukaji leta 1163 so križarji in njihovi zavezniki redko porazili Nur ad Dina Zengija, emirja Alepa in Damaska. Kralj Amalrik I. je vodil vojsko Jeruzalemskega kraljestva skupaj z odredi iz severnih latinskih držav, velikim številom romarjev, ki so ravno prispeli iz Francije, in silami, ki jih je pripeljal bizantinski guverner Kilikije. Kristjanom je zmaga prinesla le kratek predah pred vztrajno muslimansko ofenzivo.

source.title: Battle of al-Buqaia
paragraphs: In the Battle of al-Buqaia in 1163, the Crusaders and their allies inflicted a rare defeat on Nur ad-Din Zangi, the Emir of Aleppo and Damascus. King Amalric I led the army of the Kingdom of Jerusalem, together with contingents from the northern Latin states, a substantial body of pilgrims who had just arrived from France, and a force brought by the Byzantine governor of Cilicia. For the Christian forces, this victory only gave a brief respite from the sustained Muslim offensive.

Battle of al-Fule.headline: Bitka pri Al Fuli
paragraphs: V pohodu in bitki pri Al Fuli (v križarskem izrazju La Fève, latinsko Castrum Fabe) so se križarske sile pod vodstvom Guya Lusignanskega septembra in oktobra 1183 več kot teden dni spopadale s Saladinovo ajubidsko vojsko. Boji so se končali 6. oktobra, ko se je moral Saladin umakniti.

source.title: Battle of al-Fule
paragraphs: In the campaign and Battle of al-Fule (in Crusader terms La Fève, Latin Castrum Fabe), a Crusader force led by Guy of Lusignan skirmished with Saladin's Ayyubid army for more than a week in September and October 1183. The fighting ended on 6 October with Saladin being forced to withdraw.

Battle of al-Harra.headline: Bitka pri Al Hari
paragraphs: Bitka pri Al Hari (arabsko: Yawm al-Ḥarra, dobesedno »dan Al Hare«) je potekala med omajadsko vojsko kalifa Jazida I. (vladal 680–683) pod vodstvom Muslima ibn Ukbe in branilci Medine iz frakcij ansarjev in muhadžirov, ki so se uprli kalifu. Bitka je potekala na lavinem polju Harat Vakim na severovzhodnem obrobju Medine 26. avgusta 683 in je trajala manj kot dan.

source.title: Battle of al-Harra
paragraphs: The Battle of al-Harra (Arabic: يوم الحرة, romanized: Yawm al-Ḥarra, lit. 'Day of al-Harra') was fought between the Umayyad army of the caliph Yazid I (r. 680–683) led by Muslim ibn Uqba and the defenders of Medina from the Ansar and Muhajirun factions, who had rebelled against the caliph. The battle took place at the lava field of Harrat Waqim in the northeastern outskirts of Medina on 26 August 683 and lasted less than a day.

Battle of al-Qaryatayn.headline: Bitka pri Al Karjatajnu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Al Karjatajnu je bila manjša bitka med krščanskimi arabskimi Gasanidi, zavezniki Bizantinskega cesarstva, in vojsko pravovernega kalifata. Bojevali so se, potem ko je Halid ibn al Valid osvojil Tadmur v Siriji. Njegova vojska je krenila proti Al Karjatajnu, katerega prebivalci so se muslimanski vojski uprli. Premagali so jih in izropali, muslimanske sile pa so Al Karjatajn osvojile.

source.title: Battle of al-Qaryatayn
paragraphs: Battle of al-Qaryatayn was a minor battle between the Christian Ghassanid Arab allies of the Byzantine Empire, and the Rashidun Caliphate army. It was fought after Khalid ibn al-Walid had conquered Tadmur in Syria. His army marched to al-Qaryatayn, the inhabitants of which resisted the Muslim army. They were fought, defeated and plundered. This resulted in the conquest of Al-Qaryatayn by the Muslim forces.

Battle of al-Yamama.headline: Bitka pri Al Jamami
paragraphs: Bitka pri Al Jamami je potekala decembra 632 v okviru vojn Ride proti uporu v pravovernem kalifatu v pokrajini Al Jamama (v današnji Savdski Arabiji, južno od Rijada) med silami Abu Bakra in Musajlime, samozvanega preroka. Bila je del večkrat podaljšanega spopada na ravnini Akrama in v mestu Al Hadikat.

source.title: Battle of al-Yamama
paragraphs: The Battle of al-Yamama was fought in December 632 as part of the Ridda Wars against a rebellion within the Rashidun Caliphate in the region of al-Yamama (in present-day Saudi Arabia, south of Riyadh) between the forces of Abu Bakr and Musaylima, a self-proclaimed prophet. This battle was a part of a multi-prolonged engagement in the plains of Aqrama and the city of Al-Hadiqat.

Battle of Aleppo (2012–2016).headline: Bitka za Alep (2012–2016)
paragraphs: Bitka za Alep (arabsko: Maʿrakat Ḥalab) je bil velik vojaški spopad v Alepu, po mestni površini največjem sirskem mestu, med sirskimi opozicijskimi milicami (kot so Svobodna sirska vojska, Levantska fronta in Fronta al Nusra) na eni strani ter baatistično sirsko vlado in vojsko, ki so jo podpirali Rusija, Iran, Hezbolah in druge šiitske borbene skupine pod okriljem iranske revolucionarne garde ter druge provladne sirske in palestinske milice, na drugi, pa tudi proti kurdskim Enotam za zaščito ljudstva (YPG). Bitka se je začela 19. julija 2012 in je bila del sirske državljanske vojne. Pat, ki je trajal štiri leta, se je končal julija 2016, ko so baatistične vladne čete ob podpori ruskih letalskih napadov zaprle zadnjo oskrbovalno pot upornikov v Alep. Uporniki so septembra in oktobra sprožili neuspešne protiofenzive, ki niso prebile vladnega obleganja vzhodne polovice mesta, ki so jo držali uporniki; novembra pa so vladne sile, zavezniške Rusiji in okrepljene z enotami YPG, začele odločilni pohod, s katerim so do decembra 2016 znova zavzele ves Alep. Zmaga sirske vlade je splošno veljala za prelomnico državljanske vojne.

source.title: Battle of Aleppo (2012–2016)
paragraphs: The Battle of Aleppo (Arabic: مَعْرَكَةُ حَلَبَ, romanized: Maʿrakat Ḥalab) was a major military confrontation in Aleppo, the largest city in Syria by urban area, between the Syrian opposition militias (such as the Free Syrian Army (FSA), the Levant Front and Al-Nusra Front) against the Ba'athist Syrian government and army, supported by Russia, Iran, Hezbollah and other Shia militant groups backed by the IRGC, and other pro-government Syrian and Palestinian militias, and against the Kurdish-majority People's Protection Units (YPG). The battle began on 19 July 2012 and was part of the Syrian civil war. A stalemate that had been in place for four years finally ended in July 2016, when Ba'athist government troops closed the rebels' last supply line into Aleppo with the support of Russian airstrikes. In response, rebel forces launched unsuccessful counteroffensives in September and October that failed to break the government's siege of the rebel-held eastern half of the city; in November, government forces, allied with Russia and bolstered by YPG forces, embarked on a decisive campaign that resulted in the recapture of all of Aleppo by December 2016. The Syrian government victory was widely seen as a turning point in the civil war.

Battle of Aleppo (2024).headline: Bitka za Alep (2024)
paragraphs: Bitka za Alep (2024), znana tudi kot druga bitka za Alep ali padec Alepa, se je začela, ko je sirska opozicijska skupina Hajat Tahrir al Šam skupaj z zavezniškimi skupinami pod turškim okriljem v poveljstvu vojaških operacij vstopila v Alep, ki ga je držala sirska vlada. Bitka se je začela tretji dan obsežne uporniške ofenzive. V mestu se je takrat boj vnel prvič po prejšnji bitki, ki se je začela leta 2012 in končala leta 2016, ko je Asadova oblast upornike pregnala iz mesta.

Opozicijske skupine so 30. novembra 2024 ob razpadu provladnih sil zavzele večji del mesta. Hkrati z bliskovitim zavzetjem Alepa so uporniki prodrli na podeželje severne Hame, celotno mesto Hama pa je uporniškim silam padlo 5. decembra.

source.title: Battle of Aleppo (2024)
paragraphs: The Battle of Aleppo (2024), also known as the Second Battle of Aleppo or the Fall of Aleppo began when the Syrian opposition group Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham, along with allied Turkish-backed groups in the Military Operations Command, entered the Syrian government-held city of Aleppo. The battle began on the third day of a large-scale rebel offensive. It was the first time fighting had broken out in the city since the earlier battle, which began in 2012 and ended in 2016 when the Assad administration pushed rebels out of the city.

On 30 November 2024, opposition groups captured most of the city amidst the collapse of pro-government forces. Coinciding with the lightning-speed takeover of Aleppo, the rebels pushed into the countryside of northern Hama; the whole city of Hama eventually fell to the rebels on 5 December.

Bitka pri Akabi je med arabskim uporom v prvi svetovni vojni potekala za pristanišče Akaba ob Rdečem morju (danes v Jordaniji). Napadalne sile pod vodstvom šerifa Nasirja in Aude abu Tajija, ki jim je svetoval T. E. Lawrence (»Lawrence Arabski«), so premagale branilce Osmanskega cesarstva.

source.title: Battle of Aqaba
paragraphs: The Battle of Aqaba was fought for the Red Sea port of Aqaba (now in Jordan) during the Arab Revolt of World War I. The attacking forces, led by Sherif Nasir and Auda abu Tayi and advised by T. E. Lawrence ("Lawrence of Arabia"), were victorious over the Ottoman Empire defenders.

Bitka pri Arsufu je potekala 7. septembra 1191 v okviru tretje križarske vojne. Večnarodna križarska vojska pod vodstvom angleškega kralja Riharda I. je premagala precej večjo vojsko ajubidskega sultanata pod vodstvom Saladina.

source.title: Battle of Arsuf
paragraphs: The Battle of Arsuf took place on 7 September 1191, as part of the Third Crusade. It saw a multi-national force of Crusaders, led by Richard I of England, defeat a significantly larger army of the Ayyubid Sultanate, led by Saladin.

Battle of Avarayr.headline: Bitka pri Avarajru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Avarajru (armensko: Ավարայրի ճակատամարտ) je potekala 26. maja 451 na ravnini Avarajr v Vaspurakanu med krščansko armensko vojsko pod vodstvom Vardana Mamikonjana in sasanidsko Perzijo.
