Velja za eno prvih bitk v obrambo krščanske vere. Perzijci so na bojišču sicer zmagali, a je bila to pirova zmaga: Armenci so smeli še naprej svobodno izpovedovati krščanstvo.
Bitka velja za enega najpomembnejših dogodkov armenske zgodovine. Poveljnik armenskih sil Vardan Mamikonjan je narodni junak, Armenska apostolska cerkev pa ga je razglasila za svetnika.

source.title: Battle of Avarayr
paragraphs: The Battle of Avarayr (Armenian: Ավարայրի ճակատամարտ, romanized: Avarayri chakatamart) was fought on 26 May 451 on the Avarayr Plain in Vaspurakan between a Christian Armenian army under Vardan Mamikonian and Sassanid Persia. It is considered one of the first battles in defense of the Christian faith. Although the Persians were victorious on the battlefield, it was a pyrrhic victory. The Armenians were allowed to continue practising Christianity freely.

The battle is seen as one of the most significant events in Armenian history. The commander of the Armenian forces, Vardan Mamikonian, is considered a national hero and has been canonized by the Armenian Apostolic Church.

Battle of Ayn al-Tamr.headline: Bitka pri Ajn al Tamru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ajn al Tamru (arabsko: معركة عين التمر) je potekala na območju današnjega Iraka (Mezopotamije) med zgodnjimi muslimanskimi arabskimi silami ter Sasanidi in njihovimi krščanskimi arabskimi pomožnimi enotami. Ajn al Tamr leži zahodno od Anbarja in je bil obmejna postojanka, ustanovljena v pomoč Sasanidom.

Muslimani pod poveljstvom Halida ibn al Valida so prepričljivo premagali sasanidske pomožne sile, med katerimi je bilo veliko nemuslimanskih Arabcev, ki so prelomili prejšnje zaveze z muslimani. Po Williamu Muirju je Halid ibn al Valid lastnoročno zajel krščanskega arabskega poveljnika Aka ibn Kajsa ibn Bašira, kar se ujema s pripovedma Ibn al Asira v delu Usd al ghabah fi marifat al Sahabah in Tabarija v njegovi Zgodovini (Tarikh).

source.title: Battle of Ayn al-Tamr
paragraphs: The Battle of Ayn al-Tamr (Arabic: معركة عين التمر) took place in modern-day Iraq (Mesopotamia) between the early Muslim Arab forces and the Sassanians along with their Arab Christian auxiliary forces. Ayn al-Tamr is located west of Anbar and was a frontier post which had been established to aid the Sassanids.

The Muslims under Khalid ibn al-Walid's command soundly defeated the Sassanian auxiliary force, which included large numbers of non-Muslim Arabs who broke earlier covenants with the Muslims. According to William Muir, Khalid ibn al-Walid captured the Arab Christian commander, Aqqa ibn Qays ibn Bashir, with his own hands, which matched the accounts of both Ibn Atheer in his Usd al-ghabah fi marifat al-Saḥabah, and Tabari in his Tarikh.

Battle of Ayn al-Warda.headline: Bitka pri Ajn al Vardi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ajn al Vardi (arabsko: مَعْرَكَة‌ عَيْن ٱلْوَرْدَة) je potekala v začetku januarja 685 med omajadsko vojsko in spokorniki (tavabin). Spokorniki so bili skupina Kufancev, privržencev Alidov, pod vodstvom Sulajmana ibn Surada, Mohamedovega tovariša, ki so se hoteli oddolžiti, ker leta 680 niso pomagali Huseinu ibn Aliju v njegovem spodletelem uporu proti Omajadom. Kufanci, privrženci Alidov, so Huseina nagovarjali k uporu proti omajadskemu kalifu Jazidu, a mu niso pomagali, ko je leta 680 padel v bitki pri Karbali. Sprva majhno podtalno gibanje je po Jazidovi smrti leta 683 dobilo široko podporo v Iraku. Večina privržencev ga je zapustila malo pred odhodom v severno Sirijo, kjer se je za ofenzivo proti Iraku zbirala velika omajadska vojska pod poveljstvom Ubajda Alaha ibn Zijada. V tridnevni bitki, ki je sledila pri Ras al Ajnu, so majhno vojsko spokornikov uničili, njene glavne voditelje, med njimi Ibn Surada, pa ubili. Bitka je bila kljub temu predhodnica in navdih poznejšega, uspešnejšega gibanja Muhtarja al Sakafija.

source.title: Battle of Ayn al-Warda
paragraphs: The Battle of Ayn al-Warda (Arabic: مَعْرَكَة‌ عَيْن ٱلْوَرْدَة) was fought in early January 685 between the Umayyad army and the Penitents (Tawwabin). The Penitents were a group of pro-Alid Kufans led by Sulayman ibn Surad, a companion of Muhammad, who wished to atone for their failure to assist Husayn ibn Ali in his abortive uprising against the Umayyads in 680. Pro-Alid Kufans had urged Husayn to revolt against the Umayyad caliph Yazid but then failed to assist him when he was killed in the Battle of Karbala in 680. Initially a small underground movement, the Penitents received widespread support in Iraq after the death of Yazid in 683. They were deserted by most of their supporters shortly before the departure to northern Syria where a large Umayyad army under the command of Ubayd Allah ibn Ziyad had mustered in preparation for an offensive against Iraq. In the three-day long battle that ensued at Ras al-Ayn, the small Penitent army was annihilated and its senior leaders, including Ibn Surad, were killed. Nevertheless, this battle proved to be a forerunner and source of motivation for the later more successful movement of Mukhtar al-Thaqafi.

Battle of Azaz (1030).headline: Bitka pri Azazu (1030)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Azazu je potekala avgusta 1030 blizu sirskega mesta Azaz med bizantinsko vojsko, ki jo je osebno vodil cesar Roman III. Argir (vladal 1028–1034), in silami mirdasidskega emirata Alep, ki jim je prav tako osebno poveljeval emir Šibl al Daula Nasr (vladal 1029–1038). Mirdasidi so premagali precej večjo bizantinsko vojsko in zaplenili velik plen, čeprav zmage nazadnje niso znali izkoristiti.

source.title: Battle of Azaz (1030)
paragraphs: The Battle of Azaz was an engagement fought in August 1030 near the Syrian town of Azaz between the Byzantine army, led by Emperor Romanos III Argyros (r. 1028–1034) in person, and the forces of the Mirdasid Emirate of Aleppo, likewise under the personal command of Emir Shibl al-Dawla Nasr (r. 1029–1038). The Mirdasids defeated the much larger Byzantine army and took great booty, even though they were eventually unable to capitalise on their victory.

Battle of Azaz (1125).headline: Bitka pri Azazu (1125)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Azazu je potekala 11. junija 1125 med križarskimi silami jeruzalemskega kralja Balduina II. in zavezniškimi muslimanskimi silami pod vodstvom Ak Sunkurja al Bursukija, seldžuškega atabega Mosula. Bila je eden najbolj krvavih spopadov pred drugo križarsko vojno in se je končala z odločilno zmago križarjev, kar je zamajalo razmerje moči v Levantu in oslabilo seldžuško prevlado na tem območju. Sodobni kronist Matej iz Edese celo pravi, da so ostanke Bursukijeve vojske preganjali vse do Alepa. Bitka je dejansko končala obleganje Azaza in preprečila, da bi mesto padlo v turkmenske roke. (Po enem viru je bitka potekala 13. junija.)

source.title: Battle of Azaz (1125)
paragraphs: The Battle of Azaz was fought on 11 June 1125 between King Baldwin II of Jerusalem's crusader forces and allied Muslim forces led by Aq-Sunqur al-Bursuqi, the Seljuq atabeg of Mosul. One of the bloodiest confrontations before the Second Crusade, the battle resulted in a decisive victory for the Crusaders, causing disturbances of power in the Levant and weakening Seljuk domination in the area. Contemporary chronicler Matthew of Edessa even states that the remnants of al-Bursuqi's army were chased all the way to Aleppo. The battle effectively lifted the siege of Azaz and prevented it from falling to Turkoman hands. (One authority says the battle was fought on June 13.)

Battle of Ba'rin.headline: Bitka pri Barinu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Barinu (znana tudi kot bitka pri Montferrandu) leta 1137 je potekala v Siriji, ko je Zengi, atabeg Mosula in Alepa, razpršil in porazil križarske sile pod poveljstvom jeruzalemskega kralja Fulka. Zaradi tega poraza so križarji za vedno izgubili grad Montferrand v Barinu.

source.title: Battle of Ba'rin
paragraphs: The Battle of Ba'rin (also known as Battle of Montferrand) in 1137 took place in Syria when a Crusader force commanded by King Fulk of Jerusalem was scattered and defeated by Zengi, the atabeg of Mosul and Aleppo. This setback resulted in the permanent loss of the Crusader castle of Montferrand in Baarin.

Bitka pri Badru, včasih imenovana tudi napad na Badr (arabsko: Ghazwatu Badr), v Koranu in pri muslimanih pa tudi dan razločevanja (Yawm al-Furqan), je potekala 13. marca 624 n. št. (17. ramadana leta 2 po hidžri) blizu mesta Badr v provinci Medina v današnji Savdski Arabiji. Mohamed je z vojsko svojih tovarišev (sahaba) premagal vojsko Kurajšitov pod vodstvom Amra ibn Hišama, med muslimani bolj znanega kot Abu Džahl. Bitka je pomenila začetek šestletne vojne med Mohamedom in njegovim plemenom.
notes: The pronunciation in IPA is left out.

source.title: Battle of Badr
paragraphs: The Battle of Badr or sometimes called The Raid of Badr (Arabic: غَزْوَةُ بَدْرٍ [ɣazwatu badr]; Ghazwatu Badr), also referred to as The Day of the Criterion (Arabic: يَوْمُ الْفُرْقَانْ, Arabic pronunciation: [jawm'ul fur'qaːn]; Yawm al-Furqan) in the Qur'an and by Muslims, was fought on 13 March 624 CE (17 Ramadan, 2 AH), near the city of Badr, Medina Province in present-day Saudi Arabia. Muhammad, commanding an army of his Sahaba, defeated an army of the Quraysh led by Amr ibn Hisham, better known among Muslims as Abu Jahl. The battle marked the beginning of the six-year war between Muhammad and his tribe.
Bitka za Bagdad (arabsko: Maʿrakatu baghdād), znana tudi kot padec Bagdada (suqūṭu baghdād), je bil vojaški spopad, ki je v začetku aprila 2003 potekal v Bagdadu v okviru invazije na Irak.

Tri tedne po začetku invazije so enote kopenskega poveljstva koalicijskih sil pod vodstvom 3. pehotne divizije ameriške vojske zavzele Bagdad. V bitki je padlo več kot 2000 iraških vojakov in 34 koalicijskih vojakov.

Po padcu Bagdada so koalicijske sile 10. aprila vstopile v Kirkuk, 15. aprila 2003 pa v Tikrit. Združene države so 15. aprila uradno razglasile zmago nad iraškim režimom Sadama Huseina, predsednik George W. Bush pa je 1. maja imel govor »Naloga opravljena«.

source.title: Battle of Baghdad (2003)
paragraphs: The Battle of Baghdad (Arabic: مَعْرَكَةُ بَغْدَاد, romanized: Maʿrakatu baghdād), also known as the Fall of Baghdad (Arabic: سُقُوطُ بَغْدَاد, romanized: suqūṭu baghdād), was a military engagement that took place in Baghdad in early April 2003, as part of the invasion of Iraq.

Three weeks into the invasion of Iraq, Coalition Forces Land Component Command elements, led by the U.S. Army 3rd Infantry Division, captured Baghdad. Over 2,000 Iraqi soldiers as well as 34 coalition troops were killed in the battle.

After the fall of Baghdad, Coalition forces entered the city of Kirkuk on April 10 and Tikrit on April 15, 2003. The United States officially declared victory against the Iraqi regime of Saddam Hussein on April 15, and President George W. Bush gave his Mission Accomplished speech on May 1.

Battle of Baghuz Fawqani.headline: Bitka za Baguz Favkani
paragraphs: Bitka za Baguz Favkani je bila ofenziva Sirskih demokratičnih sil (SDF) ob podpori letalskih napadov, topništva in specialnih enot koalicije Združena operativna skupina – operacija Neomajna odločnost (CJTF-OIR), ki se je začela 9. februarja 2019 v okviru kampanje za Dejr ez Zor v sirski državljanski vojni. Bitka, sestavljena iz vrste kopenskih napadov, je potekala v sirskem mestu Al Baguz Favkani v srednji dolini Evfrata blizu iraško-sirske meje in okolici ter je bila zadnja ozemeljska obramba Islamske države (IS) v vzhodni Siriji.

source.title: Battle of Baghuz Fawqani
paragraphs: The Battle of Baghuz Fawqani was an offensive by the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF), assisted by Combined Joint Task Force – Operation Inherent Resolve (CJTF-OIR) coalition airstrikes, artillery, and special forces personnel, that began on 9 February 2019 as part of the Deir ez-Zor campaign of the Syrian Civil War. The battle—which was composed of a series of ground assaults—took place in and around the Syrian town of Al-Baghuz Fawqani in the Middle Euphrates River Valley near the Iraq–Syria border, and was the territorial last stand of the Islamic State (IS) in eastern Syria.

Battle of Basra (1914).headline: Bitka za Basro (1914)
paragraphs: Bitka za Basro je bila bitka prve svetovne vojne, ki je od 11. do 22. novembra 1914 potekala južno od mesta Basra v osmanskem Iraku med britanskimi in osmanskimi četami. Končala se je tako, da so Britanci zavzeli Basro.

source.title: Battle of Basra (1914)
paragraphs: The Battle of Basra was a battle of World War I which took place south of the city of Basra, in Ottoman Iraq, between British and Ottoman troops from November 11 to November 22, 1914. The battle resulted in the British capture of Basra.

Battle of Basra (2003).headline: Bitka za Basro (2003)
paragraphs: Bitka za Basro je trajala od 21. marca do 6. aprila 2003 in je bila ena prvih bitk invazije na Irak leta 2003. Britanska 7. oklepna brigada se je 6. aprila prebila v Basro, drugo največje iraško mesto, pod nenehnimi napadi 51. divizije iraške vojske in fedajinov Sadama, deli britanskega padalskega polka pa so počistili »staro četrt« mesta, nedostopno za vozila. V Basro so vstopili šele po dveh tednih bojev, med katerimi je bila tudi največja tankovska bitka britanskih sil v tej vojni, ko so kraljevi škotski dragonci 27. marca uničili 14 zapuščenih iraških tankov.

source.title: Battle of Basra (2003)
paragraphs: The Battle of Basra lasted from 21 March to 6 April 2003 and was one of the first battles of the 2003 invasion of Iraq. The British 7 Armoured Brigade fought their way into Iraq's second-largest city, Basra, on 6 April coming under constant attack by the Iraqi Army 51st Division and Fedayeen Saddam, while elements of the British Parachute Regiment cleared the 'old quarter' of the city that was inaccessible to vehicles. Entering Basra had only been achieved after two weeks of conflict, which included the biggest tank battle of the war by British forces when the Royal Scots Dragoon Guards destroyed 14 abandoned Iraqi tanks on the 27 March.

Battle of Basra (2008).headline: Bitka za Basro (2008)
paragraphs: Bitka za Basro se je začela 25. marca 2008, ko je iraška vojska sprožila operacijo (s kodnim imenom Saulat al Fursan, po arabsko »juriš vitezov«), da bi milico Mahdijeva vojska pregnala iz južnoiraškega mesta Basra. Bila je prva velika operacija, ki jo je iraška vojska načrtovala in izvedla po invaziji leta 2003.

Koalicijska in iraška letala so patruljirala nad Basro, zbirala obveščevalne podatke in izvajala letalske napade v podporo iraškim kopenskim silam. Koalicijske sile so v enote iraške vojske vključile vojaške prehodne skupine (MiTT), ameriške specialne enote pa so izvajale skupne operacije z iraškimi specialnimi enotami (ISOF).

Iraške sile so v mestu naletele na močan odpor milice Mahdijeve vojske, ofenziva je zastala in potrebovala ameriško in britansko letalsko in topniško podporo, nazadnje pa se je končala z zastojem. V šestih dneh hudih bojev je bilo več kot 1000 mrtvih in ranjenih.

source.title: Battle of Basra (2008)
paragraphs: The Battle of Basra began on 25 March 2008, when the Iraqi Army launched an operation (code-named Saulat al-Fursan, meaning Operation Charge of the Knights in Arabic) to drive the Mahdi Army militia out of the southern Iraqi city of Basra. The operation was the first major operation to be planned and carried out by the Iraqi Army since the invasion of 2003.

Coalition and Iraqi aircraft patrolled the skies above Basra providing intelligence and carrying out air strikes in support of Iraqi forces on the ground. Coalition forces provided embedded military transition teams (MiTTs) in Iraqi Army units and American special forces also conducted joint operations with ISOF units.

Iraqi forces faced heavy resistance from Mahdi Army militia inside the city and the offensive stalled, requiring American and British air and artillery support, eventually resulting in a stand-off. More than 1,000 casualties resulted in six days of heavy fighting.

Battle of Beersheba (1917).headline: Bitka pri Beršebi (1917)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Beršebi (turško: Birüssebi Muharebesi, nemško: Schlacht von Beerscheba) je potekala 31. oktobra 1917, ko so egiptovske ekspedicijske sile (EEF) Britanskega imperija napadle in zavzele posadko osmanske armadne skupine Jildirim v Beršebi, s čimer se je začela južnopalestinska ofenziva sinajsko-palestinske kampanje prve svetovne vojne. Pehota 60. (londonske) in 74. (jeomanske) divizije XX. korpusa je 31. oktobra 1917 zjutraj z jugozahoda izvedla omejene napade, nato pa je konjeniška divizija Anzac (puščavski konjeniški korpus) sprožila vrsto napadov na močno obrambo, ki je obvladovala vzhodno stran Beršebe, in jo pozno popoldne zavzela. Kmalu zatem sta 4. in 12. polk lahke konjenice avstralske konjeniške divizije (4. brigada lahke konjenice) izvedla juriš konjeniške pehote z bajoneti v rokah, edinim orožjem za napad na konju, saj so imeli puške na hrbtu. Del obeh polkov je razjahal in napadel okope na griču Tel es Saba, ki je branil Beršebo. Preostali konjeniki so juriš nadaljevali v mesto, ga zavzeli in zajeli del umikajoče se posadke.

source.title: Battle of Beersheba (1917)
paragraphs: The Battle of Beersheba (Turkish: Birüssebi Muharebesi, German: Schlacht von Beerscheba) was fought on 31 October 1917, when the British Empire's Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF) attacked and captured the Ottoman Empire's Yildirim Army Group garrison at Beersheba, beginning the Southern Palestine Offensive of the Sinai and Palestine campaign of World War I. On 31 October 1917, infantry from the 60th (London) and the 74th (Yeomanry) Divisions of the XX Corps from the southwest conducted limited attacks in the morning, then the Anzac Mounted Division (Desert Mounted Corps) launched a series of attacks against the strong defences, which dominated the eastern side of Beersheba, resulting in their capture during the late afternoon. Shortly afterwards, the Australian Mounted Division's 4th and 12th light horse regiments (4th Light Horse Brigade) conducted a mounted infantry charge with bayonets in their hands, their only weapon for mounted attack, as their rifles were slung across their backs. Part of the two regiments dismounted to attack entrenchments on Tel es Saba defending Beersheba. The remainder of the light horsemen continued their charge into the town, capturing the place and part of the garrison as it was withdrawing.

Battle of Beirut (1912).headline: Bitka pri Bejrutu (1912)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Bejrutu je bila pomorska bitka pred bejrutsko obalo med italijansko-turško vojno. Italijani so se bali, da bi osmanske pomorske sile v Bejrutu lahko ogrozile dostop do Sueškega prekopa, zato je italijanska vojska ukazala uničiti osmansko pomorsko navzočnost na tem območju. Dve italijanski oklepni križarki sta 24. februarja 1912 napadli in potopili osmansko kazematno korveto in šest lahkih čolnov, se umaknili, nato pa se vrnili in potopili še osmanski torpedni čoln.

Bitka je uničila vse osmanske pomorske sile v pokrajini, s čimer so Italijani obdržali odprt dostop do Sueškega prekopa. Poleg pomorskih izgub je italijansko vojno ladjevje močno poškodovalo tudi samo mesto Bejrut.

source.title: Battle of Beirut (1912)
paragraphs: The Battle of Beirut was a naval battle off the coast of Beirut during the Italo-Turkish War. Italian fears that the Ottoman naval forces at Beirut could be used to threaten the approach to the Suez Canal led the Italian military to order the destruction of the Ottoman naval presence in the area. On 24 February 1912 two Italian armoured cruisers attacked and sank an Ottoman casemate corvette and six lighters, retired, then returned and sank an Ottoman torpedo boat.

As a result of the battle all Ottoman naval forces in the region were annihilated, thus ensuring the approaches to the Suez Canal were open to the Italians. Besides the naval losses, the city of Beirut itself suffered significant damage from the Italian warships.

Battle of Belvoir Castle.headline: Bitka pri gradu Belvoir
paragraphs: Bitka pri gradu Belvoir, imenovana tudi bitka pri Le Forbeletu, je bila del Saladinovega pohoda proti križarjem od maja do avgusta 1182. Križarske sile pod vodstvom jeruzalemskega kralja Balduina IV. so se spopadle z ajubidskimi silami iz Egipta pod poveljstvom Saladina. Saladin je 11. junija 1182 skupaj s svojim namestnikom Farukom Šahom krenil iz Damaska. Ko je južno od Tiberije vstopil v Palestino, je blizu gradu Belvoir naletel na križarsko vojsko, ki je prihajala iz Transjordanije.
Bojišče je obsegalo Ajlo, Transjordanijo, Galilejo in Bejrut.

source.title: Battle of Belvoir Castle
paragraphs: The Battle of Belvoir Castle, also called the Battle of Le Forbelet, was a part of Saladin's campaign in May — August 1182 against the Crusaders. Crusader forces led by King Baldwin IV of Jerusalem battled with Ayyubid forces from Egypt commanded by Saladin. Saladin took action in Damascus on June 11, 1182, together with his regent Farrukh Shah. Entering Palestine from the south of Tiberias, Saladin encountered the Crusader army coming from Transjordan near Belvoir Castle.
The theatre of operations included Ayla, Transjordan, Galilee and Beirut.

Battle of Bosra.headline: Bitka pri Bosri
paragraphs: Bitka pri Bosri je leta 634 n. št. potekala med vojsko pravovernega kalifata in Bizantinskim cesarstvom za mesto Bosra v Siriji. Mesto je bilo ena prvih pomembnih islamskih osvojitev in tedaj prestolnica Gasanidov, arabskih vazalov Bizantincev. Obleganje je potekalo med junijem in julijem.

source.title: Battle of Bosra
paragraphs: The Battle of Bosra was fought in 634 CE between the Rashidun Caliphate army and the Byzantine Empire over the possession of the city of Bosra, in Syria. The city was one of the Islamic forces' first significant captures and was at the time the capital of the Ghassanids, Arab vassals of the Byzantines. The siege took place between June and July.

Battle of Buzakha.headline: Bitka pri Buzahi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Buzahi je bila velika bitka vojn Ride ali vojn odpadništva. Septembra 632 sta se v njej spopadli vojska pravovernega kalifata pod poveljstvom Halida ibn al Valida in sile odpadnikov pod vodstvom Tulajhe.

source.title: Battle of Buzakha
paragraphs: The Battle of Buzakha was a major military battle in the Ridda Wars or Wars of Apostasy. It took place between the army of the Rashidun Caliphate under command of Khalid ibn al-Walid and the Apostate forces under Tulayha, in September 632.

Battle of Callinicum.headline: Bitka pri Kalinikonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Kalinikonu je potekala na veliko soboto, 19. aprila 531, med Bizantinskim in Sasanidskim cesarstvom med iberijsko vojno.

source.title: Battle of Callinicum
paragraphs: The Battle of Callinicum took place on Easter Saturday, 19 April 531, between the Byzantine Empire and Sasanian Empire during the Iberian War.

Battle of Carchemish.headline: Bitka pri Karkemišu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Karkemišu je okoli leta 605 pr. n. št. potekala med vojskami Egipta, zavezanega ostankom Novoasirskega cesarstva, in vojskami Babilonije. Vojski sta se spopadli pri Karkemišu, pomembnem vojaškem prehodu in trgovskem mestu na bregovih Evfrata v današnji Siriji. Babilonski vojski je poveljeval Nebukadnezar II., njegov oče, babilonski kralj Nabopolasar, pa je ostal v Babilonu. Egiptovske in asirske sile je vodil egiptovski kralj Neho II. Bitka se je končala s hudim porazom Egipčanov in Asircev, ki je končal egiptovski vpliv v Levantu, Babilon pa je svojo oblast razširil do egiptovskih meja.

source.title: Battle of Carchemish
paragraphs: The Battle of Carchemish was a battle fought around 605 BCE between the armies of Egypt, allied with the remnants of the Neo-Assyrian Empire, against the armies of Babylonia. The forces would clash at Carchemish, an important military crossing and trade city on the banks of the Euphrates River in modern-day Syria. Nebuchadnezzar II was given command of this Babylonian force while Nabopolassar, his father and the king of Babylonia, was still in Babylon. Necho II, the king of Egypt, led the Egyptian and Assyrian forces in the battle. The battle would end in a major defeat for the Egyptian and Assyrian forces. The defeat ended Egyptian influence in the Levant and led to Babylon expanding its domain to the borders of Egypt.

Battle of Chains.headline: Bitka verig
paragraphs: Bitka pri Salasilu (arabsko: Dhat al-Salasil), pogosto imenovana bitka verig, je bila prva bitka med pravovernim kalifatom in Sasanidskim perzijskim imperijem aprila 633. Potekala je v Kazimi (današnji Kuvajt) med silami Halida ibn al Valida in Perzijci pod vodstvom Hormozda. Bojevali so se kmalu po koncu vojn Ride, ko je bil Arabski polotok združen pod oblastjo kalifa Abu Bakra. Bila je prva bitka pravovernega kalifata, v kateri se je muslimanska vojska odločila razširiti meje zunaj Arabije, s čimer so se začela arabska osvajanja.

source.title: Battle of Chains
paragraphs: The Battle of Sallasil (Arabic: معركة ذات السلاسل Dhat al-Salasil), often referred to as the Battle of Chains, was the first battle fought between the Rashidun Caliphate and the Sasanian Persian Empire in April 633. The battle was fought in Kazima (present day Kuwait) by the forces of Khalid ibn al-Walid and the Persians under Hormozd. It was fought soon after the Ridda Wars were over and the Arabian Peninsula was united under the authority of the Caliph Abu Bakr. Indeed, it was the first battle of the Rashidun Caliphate in which the Muslim army elected to extend its frontiers outside of Arabia, thus initiating the Arab conquests.

Battle of Chaldiran.headline: Bitka pri Čaldiranu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Čaldiranu (perzijsko: جنگ چالدران; turško: Çaldıran Savaşı) je potekala 23. avgusta 1514 in se je končala z odločilno zmago Osmanskega cesarstva nad Safavidskim imperijem. Osmani so safavidskemu Iranu odvzeli vzhodno Anatolijo in gornjo Mezopotamijo. Bitka je pomenila prvo osmansko širitev v vzhodno Anatolijo in ustavila safavidsko širjenje proti zahodu. Bila je šele začetek 41 let uničujoče vojne med Safavidi in Osmani, ki se je končala šele leta 1555 z amasijskim mirom. Safavidi so Mezopotamijo in vzhodno Anatolijo sicer znova osvojili med vladavino Abasa Velikega (vladal 1588–1629), a so ju z zuhabsko pogodbo leta 1639 za vedno prepustili Osmanom.

source.title: Battle of Chaldiran
paragraphs: The Battle of Chaldiran (Persian: جنگ چالدران; Turkish: Çaldıran Savaşı) took place on 23 August 1514 and ended with a decisive victory for the Ottoman Empire over the Safavid Empire. As a result, the Ottomans annexed Eastern Anatolia and Upper Mesopotamia from Safavid Iran. It marked the first Ottoman expansion into Eastern Anatolia, and the halt of the Safavid expansion to the west. The Battle of Chaldiran was just the beginning of 41 years of destructive war between the Safavids and Ottomans, which only ended in 1555 with the Peace of Amasya. Though the Safavids eventually reconquered Mesopotamia and Eastern Anatolia during the reign of Abbas the Great (r. 1588–1629), they would be permanently ceded to the Ottomans by the 1639 Treaty of Zuhab.

Battle of Cresson.headline: Bitka pri Cressonu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Cressonu je bila manjša bitka med frankovskimi in egiptovskimi ajubidskimi silami 1. maja 1187 pri »studencu Cresson«. Natančna lega studenca ni znana, ležal pa je v okolici Nazareta. Spopad je bil uvod v odločilni poraz Jeruzalemskega kraljestva v bitki pri Hattinu dva meseca pozneje.

source.title: Battle of Cresson
paragraphs: The Battle of Cresson was a small battle between Frankish and Egyptian Ayyubid forces on 1 May 1187 at the "Spring of the Cresson." While the exact location of the spring is unknown, it is located in the environs of Nazareth. The conflict was a prelude to the decisive defeat of the Kingdom of Jerusalem at the Battle of Hattin two months later.

Battle of Ctesiphon (1915).headline: Bitka pri Ktezifonu (1915)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ktezifonu (turško: Selman-ı Pak Muharebesi) je potekala novembra 1915 med Britanskim imperijem in Osmanskim cesarstvom v okviru mezopotamske kampanje prve svetovne vojne.

Indijske ekspedicijske sile D, sestavljene večinoma iz indijskih enot pod poveljstvom generala sira Johna Nixona, so bile v osmanskem Iraku uspešne, odkar so se 5. novembra 1914, ko je Osmansko cesarstvo napovedalo vojno, izkrcale na polotoku Al Fav.

Eden glavnih razlogov za mezopotamsko kampanjo je bila obramba rafinerije v Abadanu ob ustju Šat al Araba. Britanska vojska pod vodstvom generala Townshenda je po politiki prednje obrambe odbila vrsto manjših osmanskih sil. Po letu zaporednih porazov pa so osmanske sile v dveh dneh hudih bojev pri Ktezifonu ustavile britansko napredovanje.

source.title: Battle of Ctesiphon (1915)
paragraphs: The Battle of Ctesiphon (Turkish: Selman-ı Pak Muharebesi) was fought in November 1915 by the British Empire, against the Ottoman Empire, within the Mesopotamian Campaign of World War I.

Indian Expeditionary Force D, mostly made up of Indian units and under the command of Gen. Sir John Nixon, had met with success in Ottoman Iraq since it had landed at Al-Faw Peninsula upon the Ottoman Empire's declaration of war on 5 November 1914.

One of the primary reasons for initiating the campaign in Mesopotamia was to defend the oil refinery at Abadan at the mouth of the Shatt al-Arab. Adopting a forward defence policy, the British army under General Townshend fought off a series of small Ottoman forces. Then after a year of a string of defeats, the Ottoman forces were able to halt the British advance in two days of hard fighting at Ctesiphon.

Battle of Ctesiphon (363).headline: Bitka pri Ktezifonu (363)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Ktezifonu je potekala 29. maja 363 med vojskami rimskega cesarja Julijana in vojsko Sasanidskega imperija (med vladavino Šapurja II.) pred obzidjem perzijske prestolnice Ktezifon. Rimljani so zmagali, a pohoda nazadnje niso mogli nadaljevati, ker so bili predaleč od oskrbovalnih poti.

source.title: Battle of Ctesiphon (363)
paragraphs: The Battle of Ctesiphon took place on 29 May 363 between the armies of Roman Emperor Julian and an army of the Sasanian Empire (during Shapur II's reign) outside the walls of the Persian capital Ctesiphon. The battle resulted in a Roman victory, but eventually the Roman forces found themselves unable to continue their campaign as they were too far from their supply lines.

Bitka pri Kunaksi je pozno poleti leta 401 pr. n. št. potekala med perzijskim kraljem Artakserksom II. in njegovim bratom Kirom Mlajšim za ahemenidski prestol. Velika bitka Kirovega upora je potekala 70 km severno od Babilona, pri Kunaksi (grško: Κούναξα) na levem bregu Evfrata. Glavni vir je Ksenofont, grški vojak, ki je sodeloval v bojih. Čeprav so grški najemniki in Kirove perzijske čete s skupnim delovanjem v bitki uspeli, sta izid bitke in smrt pretendenta na prestol pomenila poraz vsega upora, Grki pa so se morali podati na Anabazo, umik v domovino.

source.title: Battle of Cunaxa
paragraphs: The Battle of Cunaxa was fought in the late summer of 401 BC between the Persian king Artaxerxes II and his brother Cyrus the Younger for control of the Achaemenid throne. The great battle of the revolt of Cyrus took place 70 km north of Babylon, at Cunaxa (Greek: Κούναξα), on the left bank of the Euphrates. The main source is Xenophon, a Greek soldier who participated in the fighting. Despite the success in the battle achieved by the interaction of the Greek mercenaries and the Persian troops of Cyrus, the outcome of the battle and the death of the pretender to the throne led to the defeat of the entire uprising and forced Greeks to commit Anabasis.

Battle of Damascus (2012).headline: Bitka za Damask (2012)
paragraphs: Bitka za Damask (arabsko: معركة دمشق), znana tudi kot operacija Damaški vulkan, se je začela 15. julija 2012 med sirsko državljansko vojno. Na tisoče upornikov se je z okoliškega podeželja prikradlo v Damask. Po nekaterih poročilih so opozicijske sile nato sprožile operacijo za zavzetje prestolnice, po drugih pa je vojska za obsežno uporniško operacijo izvedela vnaprej in udarila preventivno. Po nekaterih poročilih naj bi uporniki operacijo začeli prezgodaj, ker so varnostne sile odkrile njihove načrte.

Uporniki so sprva zavzeli pol ducata četrti in v bombnem napadu ubili štiri visoke vladne ministre, po vojaškem protinapadu pa so se morali umakniti; vojska je po treh tednih bojev obdržala nadzor nad prestolnico. V središču Damaska so tedaj prvič uporabili tanke in helikopterje, deli mesta pa so ostali bojišče.

source.title: Battle of Damascus (2012)
paragraphs: The Battle of Damascus (Arabic: معركة دمشق), also known as Operation Damascus Volcano (Arabic: عملية بركان دمشق), started on 15 July 2012 during the Syrian civil war. Thousands of rebels infiltrated Damascus from the surrounding countryside. Following this, according to some reports, the opposition forces launched an operation to capture the capital, while according to other reports, the military learned of the large-scale rebel operation beforehand and made a preemptive strike. Some reports even suggested the rebels launched the operation prematurely due to their plans being discovered by the security forces.

After the rebels initially captured half a dozen districts and killed four high-ranking government ministers in a bombing, opposition forces were forced to retreat following a military counter-attack, leaving the army in control of the capital after three weeks of fighting. It was the first time tanks and helicopters had been deployed in central Damascus and left parts of the city as a warzone.

Battle of Damghan (1729).headline: Bitka pri Damganu (1729)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Damganu (perzijsko: نبرد دامغان) ali bitka pri Mehmandustu je potekala od 29. septembra do 5. oktobra 1729 blizu mesta Damgan. Končala se je s prepričljivo zmago Naderja in safavidske stvari, za katero se je zavzel. Sama po sebi Ašrafove oblasti v Iranu ni končala, bila pa je pomemben uspeh, ki je pripeljal do nadaljnjih zmag v pohodu za vrnitev Tahmaspa II. na prestol. Bitki je sledila še bitka pri Murče Hortu, vasi blizu Isfahana. Naderjeve sile so zmagale v obeh, zato je lahko gildžajsko afganistansko dinastijo odstranil s perzijskega prestola, na katerem je bila le kratek čas. Hotaki so se morali umakniti na svoje ozemlje na jugu današnjega Afganistana.

source.title: Battle of Damghan (1729)
paragraphs: The Battle of Damghan (Persian: نبرد دامغان) or Battle of Mehmandoost (Persian: نبرد مهماندوست) was fought on 29 September to 5 October 1729, near the city of Damghan. It resulted in an overwhelming victory for Nader and the Safavid cause he had taken up. Although it by itself did not end Ashraf's rule in Iran, it was a significant triumph which led to further successes in the following engagements of the campaign to restore Tahmasp II to the throne. The battle was followed by another one in Murcheh-Khort, a village near Isfahan. Nader's forces were victorious in both battles, which led him to remove the Ghilzai Afghan dynasty from their short stay on the Persian throne. The Hotakis were forced back to their territory in what is now southern Afghanistan.

Battle of Djahy.headline: Bitka pri Džahiju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Džahiju je bila velika kopenska bitka med silami faraona Ramzesa III. in morskimi ljudstvi, ki so hotela vdreti v Egipt in ga osvojiti. Spopad je potekal na skrajni vzhodni meji Egiptovskega imperija v Džahiju, današnjem južnem Libanonu, v osmem letu Ramzesa III. oziroma ok. 1178 pr. n. št.

Egipčani pod vodstvom Ramzesa III. so v bitki porazili morska ljudstva, ki so skušala vdreti v Egipt po kopnem in morju. Skoraj vse, kar o bitki vemo, izvira iz Ramzesovega pogrebnega templja v Medinet Habuju. Opis bitke in ujetnikov je podrobno zapisan na zidovih templja, kjer je tudi najdaljši znani hieroglifski napis. Reliefi v templju prikazujejo številne zvezane ujetnike, poražene v bitki.

source.title: Battle of Djahy
paragraphs: The Battle of Djahy was a major land battle between the forces of Pharaoh Ramesses III and the Sea Peoples who intended to invade and conquer Egypt. The conflict occurred on the Egyptian Empire's easternmost frontier in Djahy, or modern-day southern Lebanon, in the eighth year of Ramesses III or about c. 1178 BC.

In this battle the Egyptians, led by Ramesses III, defeated the Sea Peoples, who were attempting to invade Egypt by land and sea. Almost all that is known about the battle comes from the mortuary temple of Ramesses III in Medinet Habu. The description of the battle and prisoners is documented in detail on the temple's walls, which also contain the longest hieroglyphic inscription known. Temple reliefs feature many bound prisoners defeated in battle.

Battle of Emesa.headline: Bitka pri Emesi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Emesi je potekala leta 272 med rimskimi vojskami pod vodstvom cesarja Avrelijana ter palmirskimi silami pod vodstvom cesarice Zenobije in generala Zabde.

source.title: Battle of Emesa
paragraphs: The Battle of Emesa was fought in 272 between the Roman armies led by their emperor Aurelian and the Palmyrene forces led by their empress, Zenobia and general Zabdas.

Battle of Fahl.headline: Bitka pri Fahlu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Fahlu (arabsko: Yawm Faḥl), znana tudi kot bitka v močvirjih (Yawm al-Radagha) in bitka pri Bejsanu (Yawm Baysān), je bila velika bitka muslimanske osvojitve bizantinske Sirije, v kateri so se arabske čete pravovernega kalifata decembra 634 ali januarja 635 spopadle z bizantinskimi silami pri Peli (Fahl) in bližnjem Skitopolisu (Bejsan) v dolini Jordana ali v njuni bližini.

Bizantinske čete, ki jih je še bolel poraz v bitki pri Adžnadajnu, so se znova zbrale v Peli ali Skitopolisu, muslimani pa so jim sledili. Muslimanska konjenica je le s težavo prečkala razmočena tla okoli Bejsana, saj so Bizantinci prekopali namakalne jarke, da bi območje poplavili in zaustavili muslimansko napredovanje. Muslimani so Bizantince nazadnje premagali, ti pa naj bi utrpeli ogromne izgube. Pela je nato padla, Bejsan in bližnja Tiberija pa sta se po kratkih obleganjih vdala odredom muslimanskih čet.

source.title: Battle of Fahl
paragraphs: The Battle of Fahl (Arabic: يوم فحل, romanized: Yawm Faḥl), also known as the Battle of the Marshes (Yawm al-Radagha) and the Battle of Beisan (Yawm Baysān), was a major battle in the Muslim conquest of Byzantine Syria fought by the Arab troops of the Rashidun Caliphate and Byzantine forces at or near Pella (Fahl) and nearby Scythopolis (Beisan), both in the Jordan Valley, in December 634 or January 635.

Byzantine troops smarting from their rout by the Muslims at the battle of Ajnadayn had regrouped in Pella or Scythopolis and the Muslims pursued them there. The Muslim cavalry faced difficulty traversing the muddied grounds around Beisan as the Byzantines cut irrigation ditches to flood the area and stave off the Muslim advance. The Muslims ultimately defeated the Byzantines, who are said to have suffered enormous casualties. Pella was subsequently captured, while Beisan and nearby Tiberias capitulated after short sieges by detachments of Muslim troops.

Battle of Fakhkh.headline: Bitka pri Fahu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Fahu (arabsko: yawm Fakhkh, dobesedno »dan Faha«) je potekala 11. junija 786 med silami Abasidskega kalifata in privrženci alidskega upora v Meki pod vodstvom al Huseina ibn Alija al Abida, potomca Hasana ibn Alija.

Husein in njegovi privrženci so načrtovali vstajo v Medini med vsakoletnim romanjem hadž leta 786, a jih je k prehitremu ukrepanju prisilil spor s tamkajšnjim guvernerjem al Umarijem. Zarotniki so se uprli zjutraj 16. maja in zasedli Prerokovo mošejo, kjer so mu privrženci prisegli zvestobo. Upor med prebivalstvom ni dobil podpore, odziv abasidske posadke pa je upornikom preprečil, da bi prevzeli nadzor nad mestom, in jih nazadnje zaprl v samo mošejo. Po enajstih dneh so Alidi in njihovi privrženci, okoli 300 mož, zapustili Medino in krenili proti Meki.

source.title: Battle of Fakhkh
paragraphs: The Battle of Fakhkh (Arabic: يوم فخ, romanized: yawm Fakhkh, lit. 'Day of Fakhkh') was fought on 11 June 786 between the forces of the Abbasid Caliphate and the supporters of an Alid rebellion in Mecca under al-Husayn ibn Ali al-Abid, a descendant of Hasan ibn Ali.

Husayn and his supporters planned an uprising at Medina during the annual Hajj pilgrimage of 786, but their hand was forced by a confrontation with the local governor, al-Umari. The conspirators rose in revolt on the morning of 16 May, and seized the Prophet's Mosque, where Husayn's supporters swore allegiance to him. The revolt failed to gather support among the populace, and the reaction of the Abbasid garrison prevented the rebels from establishing control over the city, and eventually confined them to the Mosque itself. After eleven days, the Alids and their supporters, some 300 strong, abandoned Medina and headed to Mecca.

Battle of Firaz.headline: Bitka pri Firazu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Firazu (arabsko: مَعْرَكَة الْفِرَاض), znana tudi kot bitka pri Firadu, je potekala okoli januarja 634 med pravovernim kalifatom in, kot pravijo viri, združenimi silami Bizantinskega in Sasanidskega cesarstva.

source.title: Battle of Firaz
paragraphs: The Battle of Firaz (Arabic: مَعْرَكَة الْفِرَاض) also known as Battle of Firad, took place around January 634 between the Rashidun Caliphate and, reportedly, a combined force from the Byzantine Empire and Sasanian Empire.

Battle of Forbie.headline: Bitka pri La Forbieju
paragraphs: Bitka pri La Forbieju, znana tudi kot bitka pri Forbieju ali bitka pri Hiribji, je potekala 17. in 18. oktobra 1244 med zavezniškimi vojskami (iz Jeruzalemskega kraljestva, križarskih redov in odpadlih Ajubidov iz Damaska, Homsa in Keraka) in egiptovsko vojsko ajubidskega sultana as Saliha Ajuba, okrepljeno s horezmijskimi najemniki. Zmaga Ajubidov je sprožila poziv k sedmi križarski vojni in pomenila zlom krščanske moči v Sveti deželi.

source.title: Battle of Forbie
paragraphs: The Battle of Forbie, also known as the Battle of La Forbie or the Battle of Hiribya, was fought on October 17–18, 1244 between the allied armies (drawn from the Kingdom of Jerusalem, the Crusading orders, the breakaway Ayyubids of Damascus, Homs, and Kerak) and the Egyptian army of the Ayyubid Sultan as-Salih Ayyub, reinforced with Khwarezmian mercenaries. The resulting Ayyubid victory led to the call for the Seventh Crusade and marked the collapse of Christian power in the Holy Land.

Bitka pri Gabieni je bila druga velika bitka med Antigonom Enookim in Evmenom, dvema naslednikoma Aleksandra Velikega (t. i. diadohoma). Potekala je blizu Gabiene v Perziji pozimi 316–315 pr. n. št. in končala drugo diadoško vojno. Antigona je uveljavila kot najmočnejšega med nasledniki.

Ker edino poročilo o bitki izvira od Evmenovega osebnega pomočnika Hieronima iz Kardije (pozneje ga je posredoval zgodovinar Diodor), ki je pozneje prestopil k Antigonu, ponuja edinstven pogled z obeh strani.

source.title: Battle of Gabiene
paragraphs: Battle of Gabiene was the second great battle between Antigonus Monophthalmus and Eumenes, two of Alexander the Great's successors (the so-called Diadochi). The battle was fought near Gabiene in Persia in the winter of 316-315 BC and ended the Second War of the Diadochi. It established Antigonus as the most powerful of the successors.

Since the sole reference of this battle is ultimately from Eumenes' personal aide Hieronymus of Cardia (later transmitted through the historian Diodorus), who later switched his allegiance to Antigonus, he provides a unique perspective from both sides' point of view.

Battle of Gaza (2007).headline: Bitka za Gazo (2007)
paragraphs: Bitka za Gazo, znana tudi kot državljanska vojna v Gazi, je bila kratka državljanska vojna med Fatahom in Hamasom, ki je od 7. do 15. junija 2007 potekala v Gazi. Bila je vidni dogodek spora med Fatahom in Hamasom, osredotočen na boj za oblast po padcu vlade narodne enotnosti Hamasa in Fataha, ki so jo kmalu zatem razpustili. Tako so se palestinska ozemlja dejansko razdelila na dve tvorbi: Zahodni breg, ki ga upravlja Palestinska narodna oblast (PNA), in Gazo, ki jo upravlja Hamas. Hamasovi borci so prevzeli nadzor nad Gazo, uradnike Fataha pa so zajeli, usmrtili ali izgnali. Palestinski center za človekove pravice je poročal, da je bilo v bojih ubitih najmanj 161 ljudi, ranjenih pa več kot 700.

source.title: Battle of Gaza (2007)
paragraphs: The Battle of Gaza, also known as the Gaza civil war, was a brief civil war between Fatah and Hamas that took place in the Gaza Strip from 7 to 15 June 2007. It was a prominent event in the Fatah–Hamas conflict, centered on the struggle for power after the fall of the National Unity Government between Hamas and Fatah, which was dissolved shortly afterwards. This led to the de facto division of the Palestinian territories into two entities: the West Bank governed by the Palestinian National Authority (PNA), and the Gaza Strip governed by Hamas. Hamas fighters took control of the Gaza Strip, while Fatah officials were either taken as prisoners, executed, or expelled. The Palestinian Centre for Human Rights reported that at least 161 people were killed and more than 700 were wounded during the fighting.

Battle of Gaza (312 BC).headline: Bitka pri Gazi (312 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Gazi leta 312 pr. n. št. je potekala med napadalno vojsko Ptolemaja I. Soterja in njegovega zaveznika Selevka I. Nikatorja ter branilsko vojsko Demetrija I. Makedonskega, sina Antigona I. Enookega. Bila je del tretje diadoške vojne in je potekala blizu mesta Gaza.

Konec leta 312 pr. n. št. je Ptolemaj iz Egipta vdrl v Levant: z 18.000 pešci in 4000 konjeniki je krenil ob severnem robu Sinajskega polotoka. Demetrij je pravočasno dobil obveščevalne podatke, vojake odpoklical iz zimskih taborov in jih zbral pri Gazi. Svetovalci so mu, kot kaže, svetovali, naj se izogne spopadu z vojaško izkušenejšima Ptolemajem in Selevkom, a je nasvet prezrl; spopad se je končal z njegovim odločilnim porazom, Ptolemaj in Selevk pa sta nato lahko prevzela ozemlje, ki ga je nadzoroval.

source.title: Battle of Gaza (312 BC)
paragraphs: The Battle of Gaza of 312 BC, was fought between the invading army of Ptolemy I Soter and his ally Seleucus I Nicator and the defending army of Demetrius I of Macedon, son of Antigonus I Monophthalmus. The battle was part of the Third War of the Diadochi and was fought near the city of Gaza.

In late 312 BC, Ptolemy launched an invasion into the Levant from Egypt, he marched with 18,000 infantry and 4,000 cavalry along the northern edge of the Sinai Peninsula. Receiving timely intelligence, Demetrius recalled his troops from their winter quarters and concentrated them at Gaza. Demetrius' advisors had apparently told him to avoid a military confrontation with Ptolemy and Seleucus, who had more military experience, but he ignored their advice; the conflict ended in a decisive defeat for Demetrius, subsequently enabling the absorption of his controlled territory by Ptolemy and Seleucus.

Battle of Gulnabad.headline: Bitka pri Gulnabadu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Gulnabadu (paštunsko: Dh Gulonābād Jaghrha; perzijsko: Nabard-e Golūnābād) je potekala v nedeljo, 8. marca 1722, med vojaškimi silami dinastije Hotaki in vojsko Safavidskega imperija. Še bolj je zapečatila propad safavidske dinastije, ki je zatonila že desetletja.

source.title: Battle of Gulnabad
paragraphs: The Battle of Gulnabad (Pashto: د ګلون اباد جګړه, romanized: Dh Gulonābād Jaghrha; Persian: نبرد گلون‌آباد, romanized: Nabard-e Golūnābād) was fought between the military forces from the Hotak dynasty and the army of the Safavid Empire on Sunday, March 8, 1722. It further cemented the eventual fall of the Safavid dynasty, which had been declining for decades.

Battle of Hab.headline: Bitka pri Habu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Habu (arabsko: معركة هاب), znana tudi kot druga bitka pri Tel Danitu, je potekala 14. avgusta 1119, ko je križarska vojska pod poveljstvom jeruzalemskega kralja Balduina II. dosegla sporno zmago nad muslimansko vojsko Ilgazija iz Mardina, saj si je zmago pripisala tudi muslimanska vojska. Bitka je stabilizirala Antiohijsko kneževino, ki je le nekaj tednov prej doživela katastrofalen poraz. Balduin je znova zavzel vse gradove, ki jih je osvojil Ilgazi, in mu preprečil pohod nad Antiohijo.

source.title: Battle of Hab
paragraphs: The Battle of Hab (Arabic: معركة هاب), also known as the Second Battle of Tell Danith, occurred on 14 August 1119, where a Crusader army commanded by King Baldwin II of Jerusalem won a disputed victory over a Muslim army led by Ilghazi of Mardin since the Muslim army claimed it as a victory also. The battle stabilised the Principality of Antioch, which had suffered a disastrous defeat only weeks before. Baldwin managed to re-take all of the castles conquered by Ilghazi and prevented him from marching on Antioch.

Battle of Harim.headline: Bitka pri Harimu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Harimu (Harenc) je potekala 12. avgusta 1164 pri Harimu v Siriji med silami Nur ad Dina in združeno vojsko Tripolitanske grofije, Antiohijske kneževine, Bizantinskega cesarstva in Armenije. Nur ad Din je prepričljivo zmagal in zajel večino voditeljev nasprotne vojske.

source.title: Battle of Harim
paragraphs: The Battle of Harim (Harenc) was fought on 12 August 1164 at Harim, Syria, between the forces of Nur ad-Din, and a combined army from the County of Tripoli, the Principality of Antioch, the Byzantine Empire, and Armenia. Nur ad-Din won a crushing victory, capturing most of the leaders of the opposing army.

Battle of Hazir.headline: Bitka pri Haziru
paragraphs: Bitka pri Haziru ali Maarakah al Hadhir (arabsko: معركة الحاضر) je potekala med bizantinsko vojsko in elitno konjenico pravovernega kalifata, premično gardo. Potekala je junija 637, tri milje vzhodno od Kinasrina pri Al Hadhirju v današnji Siriji.

source.title: Battle of Hazir
paragraphs: The Battle of Hazir or Ma'arakah al-Haadhir (Arabic: معركة الحاضر) took place between the Byzantine army and the Rashidun army's elite cavalry, the Mobile guard. It took place in June 637, three miles east of Qinnasrin at Al-Hadher in present-day Syria.

Battle of Hira.headline: Bitka pri Hiri
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hiri (arabsko: معركة الحيرة) je potekala med Sasanidskim imperijem in pravovernim kalifatom leta 633. Bila je ena zgodnjih bitk muslimanske osvojitve Perzije. Izguba obmejnega mesta ob Evfratu je odprla pot do sasanidske prestolnice Ktezifon ob Tigrisu.

source.title: Battle of Hira
paragraphs: The Battle of Hira (Arabic: معركة الحيرة) was fought between the Sasanian Empire and the Rashidun Caliphate in 633. It was one of the early battles of the Muslim conquest of Persia. The loss of the frontier city on the Euphrates River opened the way to the Sasanian capital, Ctesiphon, on the Tigris River.

Battle of Hormozdgan.headline: Bitka pri Hormozdganu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hormozdganu (pisano tudi Hormizdagan in Hormozgan) je bila odločilna bitka med dinastijama Arsakidov in Sasanidov, ki je potekala 28. aprila 224. Sasanidska zmaga je zlomila moč partske dinastije, dejansko končala skoraj pet stoletij partske vladavine v Iranu in uradno začela sasanidsko dobo.

source.title: Battle of Hormozdgan
paragraphs: The Battle of Hormozdgan (also spelled Hormizdagan and Hormozgan) was the climactic battle between the Arsacid and the Sasanian dynasties that took place on 28 April 224. The Sasanian victory broke the power of the Parthian dynasty, effectively ending almost five centuries of Parthian rule in Iran, and marking the official start of the Sasanian era.

Bitka pri Hunajnu (arabsko: Ġazwat Ḥunayn) je bil spopad med muslimani islamskega preroka Mohameda in plemeni Kajs po osvojitvi Meke. Potekala je leta 8 po hidžri (ok. 630) v dolini Hunajn na poti od Meke do Taifa. Končala se je z odločilno zmago muslimanov in je ena redkih bitk, ki jih Koran omenja po imenu, in sicer v suri at Tauba.

source.title: Battle of Hunayn
paragraphs: The Battle of Hunayn (Arabic: غَزْوَة حُنَيْن, romanized: Ġazwat Ḥunayn) was a conflict between the Muslims of the Islamic prophet Muhammad and the tribes of Qays in the aftermath of the conquest of Mecca. The battle took place in 8 AH (c. 630) in the Hunayn valley on the route from Mecca to Taif. The battle ultimately ended in a decisive victory for the Muslims, and it is one of the few battles mentioned by name in the Quran, where it appears in Surat at-Tawbah.

Battle of Inab.headline: Bitka pri Inabu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Inabu, imenovana tudi bitka pri Ard al Hatimu ali Fons Muratus, je potekala 29. junija 1149, med drugo križarsko vojno. Zengidska vojska atabega Nur ad Dina Zengija je uničila združeno vojsko antiohijskega kneza Rajmonda in asasinov Alija ibn Vafe. Knez je padel, Antiohijsko kneževino pa so nato izropali in zmanjšali, saj se je njena vzhodna meja pomaknila proti zahodu.

source.title: Battle of Inab
paragraphs: The Battle of Inab, also called Battle of Ard al-Hâtim or Fons Muratus, was fought on 29 June 1149, during the Second Crusade. The Zengid army of the atabeg Nur al-Din Zengi destroyed the combined army of Prince Raymond of Antioch and the Assassins of Ali ibn-Wafa. The prince was killed, and the Principality of Antioch was subsequently pillaged and reduced in size as its eastern border was pushed west.

Battle of Jaffa (1192).headline: Bitka pri Jafi (1192)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Jafi je potekala med križarskimi vojnami kot eden od vrste pohodov med vojsko sultana Saladina (Ṣalāḥ al-Dīn Yūsuf ibn Ayyūb) in križarskimi silami pod vodstvom angleškega kralja Riharda I. (znanega kot Rihard Levjesrčni). Bila je zadnja bitka tretje križarske vojne, po kateri sta se Saladin in kralj Rihard lahko dogovorila o premirju. Križarji Jeruzalema sicer niso znova dobili v posest, krščanski romarji pa so smeli v mesto, križarji pa so obdržali nadzor nad precejšnjim pasom ozemlja od Bejruta do Jafe.

source.title: Battle of Jaffa (1192)
paragraphs: The Battle of Jaffa took place during the Crusades, as one of a series of campaigns between the army of Sultan Saladin (Ṣalāḥ al-Dīn Yūsuf ibn Ayyūb) and the Crusader forces led by King Richard I of England (known as Richard the Lionheart). It was the final battle of the Third Crusade, after which Saladin and King Richard were able to negotiate a truce. Although the Crusaders did not regain possession of Jerusalem, Christian pilgrims were permitted entry into the city, and the Crusaders were able to retain control of a sizable strip of land stretching from Beirut to Jaffa.

Battle of Jalula.headline: Bitka pri Džaluli
paragraphs: Bitka pri Džaluli je potekala med Sasanidskim imperijem in pravovernim kalifatom kmalu potem, ko je kalifat osvojil Ktezifon.

source.title: Battle of Jalula
paragraphs: The Battle of Jalula was fought between the Sasanian Empire and the Rashidun Caliphate soon after the conquest of Ctesiphon by the latter.

Battle of Jenin (2002).headline: Bitka za Džanin (2002)
paragraphs: Bitka za Džanin je od 1. do 11. aprila 2002 potekala v begunskem taborišču Džanin na Zahodnem bregu, ki ga zaseda Izrael. Izraelska vojska je med drugo intifado v okviru operacije Obrambni ščit vdrla v taborišče in na druga območja pod upravo palestinske oblasti.

Izraelske sile so uporabile pehoto, komandose in jurišne helikopterje. Palestinski borci so se na boj pripravili in po vsem taborišču nastavili pasti, in ko je izraelska kolona naletela na zasedo, se je vojska začela bolj zanašati na oklepne buldožerje. Palestinski borci so se 11. aprila začeli predajati, izraelske čete pa so se iz taborišča začele umikati 18. aprila.

source.title: Battle of Jenin (2002)
paragraphs: The Battle of Jenin, took place in the Jenin refugee camp in the Israeli-occupied West Bank on April 1–11, 2002. The Israeli military invaded the camp, and other areas under the administration of the Palestinian Authority, during the Second Intifada, as part of Operation Defensive Shield.

Israeli forces employed infantry, commando forces, and assault helicopters. Palestinian militants had prepared for a fight, booby trapping locations throughout the camp, and after an Israeli column walked into an ambush, the army began to rely more heavily on the use of armored bulldozers. On April 11, Palestinian militants began to surrender. Israeli troops began withdrawing from the camp on April 18.

Battle of Jerusalem.headline: Bitka za Jeruzalem (1917)
paragraphs: Bitka za Jeruzalem, znana tudi kot padec Jeruzalema, je potekala med »jeruzalemskimi operacijami« Britanskega imperija proti Osmanskemu cesarstvu v prvi svetovni vojni, ko so se boji za mesto razvili od 17. novembra in se po predaji nadaljevali do 30. decembra 1917, da bi zavarovali končni cilj južnopalestinske ofenzive v sinajsko-palestinski kampanji. Preden je bil Jeruzalem zavarovan, so Britanci priznali dve bitki v hebronskem gričevju severno in vzhodno od črte Hebron–Junction Station: bitko pri Nebi Samvilu od 17. do 24. novembra in obrambo Jeruzalema od 26. do 30. decembra 1917. V okviru jeruzalemskih operacij so priznali tudi uspešen drugi poskus prodora čez Nahr el Audžo 21. in 22. decembra 1917 kot bitko pri Jafi, čeprav je bila Jafa zasedena že po bitki pri grebenu Mughar 16. novembra.

source.title: Battle of Jerusalem
paragraphs: The Battle of Jerusalem also known as the Fall of Jerusalem occurred during the British Empire's "Jerusalem Operations" against the Ottoman Empire, in World War I, when fighting for the city developed from 17 November, continuing after the surrender until 30 December 1917, to secure the final objective of the Southern Palestine Offensive during the Sinai and Palestine Campaign of World War I. Before Jerusalem could be secured, two battles were recognised by the British as being fought in the Hebron Hills to the north and east of the Hebron–Junction Station line. These were the Battle of Nebi Samwill from 17 to 24 November and the Defence of Jerusalem from 26 to 30 December 1917. They also recognised within these Jerusalem Operations, the successful second attempt on 21 and 22 December 1917 to advance across the Nahr el Auja, as the Battle of Jaffa, although Jaffa had been occupied as a consequence of the Battle of Mughar Ridge on 16 November.

Bitka pri Karameju (arabsko: معركة الكرامة) je bil 15-urni vojaški spopad med Izraelom ter združenimi silami Jordanije in Palestinske osvobodilne organizacije (PLO) v jordanskem obmejnem mestu Karame med izčrpavalno vojno 21. marca 1968. Izrael ga je načrtoval kot enega od dveh hkratnih napadov na taborišča PLO, enega v Karameju ob reki Jordan, drugega pa v oddaljeni vasi Gor es Safi južno od Mrtvega morja.

source.title: Battle of Karameh
paragraphs: The Battle of Karameh (Arabic: معركة الكرامة) was a 15-hour military engagement between Israel and the combined forces of Jordan and the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO) in the Jordanian border town of Karameh during the War of Attrition on 21 March 1968. It was planned by Israel as one of two concurrent raids on PLO camps, one in Karameh along the Jordan River and the other in the distant village of Ghor es-Safi south of the Dead Sea.

Battle of Karbala.headline: Bitka pri Karbali
paragraphs: Bitka pri Karbali (arabsko: Maʿrakat Karbalāʾ) je potekala 10. oktobra 680 (10. muharama leta 61 po hidžri islamskega koledarja) pri Karbali na jugu današnjega Iraka, med silami drugega omajadskega kalifa Jazida I. (vladal 680–683) in majhno vojsko, ki jo je vodil Husein ibn Ali, Alijev drugi sin in vnuk islamskega preroka Mohameda.

source.title: Battle of Karbala
paragraphs: The Battle of Karbala (Arabic: مَعْرَكَة كَرْبَلَاء, romanized: Maʿrakat Karbalāʾ) was fought on 10 October 680 (10 Muharram in the year 61 AH of the Islamic calendar) between the forces of the second Umayyad caliph Yazid I (r. 680–683), and a small army led by Husayn ibn Ali, second son of Ali and grandson of the Islamic prophet Muhammad, at Karbala, in modern-day southern Iraq.

Battle of Khafji.headline: Bitka pri Hafdžiju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hafdžiju je bil prvi večji kopenski spopad zalivske vojne. Potekala je od 29. januarja do 1. februarja 1991 v savdskem mestu Hafdži in okolici.

Iraški voditelj Sadam Husein je že prej neuspešno skušal koalicijske sile zvabiti v drage kopenske spopade, tako da je obstreljeval savdske položaje in naftne rezervoarje ter na Izrael izstreljeval rakete zemlja-zemlja scud, zdaj pa je ukazal vdor v Savdsko Arabijo z juga Kuvajta. 1. in 5. mehanizirana divizija ter 3. oklepna divizija so dobile ukaz, naj z več strani vdrejo proti Hafdžiju in se ob obali spopadejo s savdskimi, kuvajtskimi in ameriškimi silami, podporne iraške komandoske enote pa naj se po morju prikradejo južneje in nadlegujejo koalicijsko zaledje.

source.title: Battle of Khafji
paragraphs: The Battle of Khafji was the first major ground engagement of the Gulf War. It took place in and around the Saudi Arabian city of Khafji, from 29 January to 1 February 1991.

Iraqi leader Saddam Hussein, who had already tried and failed to draw Coalition forces into costly ground engagements by shelling Saudi Arabian positions and oil storage tanks and firing Scud surface-to-surface missiles at Israel, ordered the invasion of Saudi Arabia from southern Kuwait. The 1st and 5th Mechanized Divisions and 3rd Armored Division were ordered to conduct a multi-pronged invasion toward Khafji, engaging Saudi Arabian, Kuwaiti, and U.S. forces along the coastline, with a supporting Iraqi commando force ordered to infiltrate further south by sea and harass the Coalition's rear.

Battle of Khasham.headline: Bitka pri Hašamu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Hašamu, znana tudi kot bitka pri poljih Conoco, je bil vojaški spopad sirske državljanske vojne, ki je potekal 7. februarja 2018 blizu krajev Hašam in Al Tabija v guvernoratu Dejr ez Zor v Siriji. Koalicija operacije Neomajna odločnost je izvedla letalske in topniške napade na sirske oborožene sile in provladne milice, potem ko so te domnevno napadle položaj ameriške vojske in Sirskih demokratičnih sil (SDF) v pokrajini.

source.title: Battle of Khasham
paragraphs: The Battle of Khasham, also known as the Battle of Conoco Fields, was a military engagement of the Syrian civil war fought on 7 February 2018 near the towns of Khasham and Al Tabiyeh in the Deir ez-Zor Governorate, Syria. The Operation Inherent Resolve coalition delivered air and artillery strikes on Syrian Armed Forces and pro-government militias after they reportedly engaged a U.S. military and Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) position in the region.

Bitka pri Hajbarju (arabsko: Ghazwatu Khaybar) je bil oborožen spopad med zgodnjimi muslimani in judovsko skupnostjo v Hajbarju leta 628 n. št. V Hajbarju, ki leži približno 150 kilometrov severozahodno od Medine, je živela velika skupnost judovskih plemen.

Ko je Mohamedova vojska krenila proti Hajbarju, Banu Gatafan in druga z Judi zavezniška arabska plemena niso poslala ali niso mogla poslati pričakovanih okrepitev za obrambo naselbine, kar je še bolj ogrozilo slabe utrdbe judovske vojske. Po kratkem boju je Hajbar padel v roke muslimanov, judovski poveljnik Marhab ibn al Harit pa je padel, kot pravijo viri, od roke Alija ibn Abi Taliba.

source.title: Battle of Khaybar
paragraphs: The Battle of Khaybar (Arabic: غزوة خيبر, romanized: Ghazwatu Khaybar) was an armed confrontation between the early Muslims and the Jewish community of Khaybar in 628 CE. Khaybar, which is located approximately 150 kilometres (93 mi) to the northwest of Medina, was home to a sizable community of Jewish tribes.

As Muhammad's army began to march on Khaybar, the Banu Ghatafan and other Jewish-allied Arabian tribes did not, or could not, send the reinforcements that had been expected to arrive to defend the settlement, further endangering the Jewish army's poor fortifications. After a brief period of fighting, Khaybar fell to the Muslims and the Jewish commander Marhab ibn al-Harith was killed, reportedly by Ali ibn Abi Talib.

Battle of Khorramshahr (1980).headline: Bitka za Horamšahr (1980)
paragraphs: Prva bitka za Horamšahr je bila velika bitka iransko-iraške vojne, ki se je začela kmalu po iraškem vdoru v Iran septembra 1980. Med izčrpavajočimi uličnimi boji v mestu in okolici so Iranci Horamšahr začeli imenovati Huninšahr (perzijsko: خونین شهر, dobesedno »krvavo mesto«), saj sta obe strani v bojih utrpeli hude izgube. Bila je največja posamična ulična bitka iransko-iraške vojne.

Irak je mesto nazadnje zavzel, a drago: ofenziva na Horamšahr, ki je trajala 34 dni, je zahtevala ogromno vojakov, precej več, kot so predvidevali iraški vojni načrti. Ta izjemna zamuda je Iranu omogočila, da je ustalil fronte pri Dezfulu, Ahvazu in Susangerdu, in tako razmeroma hitro mobiliziral iranske okrepitve v z nafto bogati Huzestan, ki si ga je hotel Irak priključiti. Ob iraški ofenzivi so Horamšahr branili predvsem številčno močno podrejeni takavarani, nekatere enote 92. oklepne divizije, pasdarani in krajevne civilne milice.

source.title: Battle of Khorramshahr (1980)
paragraphs: The First Battle of Khorramshahr was a major battle in the Iran–Iraq War, beginning shortly after the Iraqi invasion of Iran in September 1980. Amidst the gruelling urban warfare in and around the city, Khorramshahr came to be referred to by the Iranians as Khuninshahr (Persian: خونین شهر, lit. 'City of Blood'), as both sides had suffered heavy casualties in combat. It was the single largest urban battle of the Iran–Iraq war.

Though Iraq ultimately captured the city, it had come at a high cost; the offensive into Khorramshahr, which took 34 days, drew an immense investment of troops, far beyond what Iraqi war plans had envisaged. The incredible delay allowed Iran to stabilize the frontlines at Dezful, Ahvaz, and Susangerd, consequently enabling the relatively swift mobilization of Iranian reinforcements into oil-rich Khuzestan, which Iraq had sought to annex. At the time of the Iraqi offensive, Khorramshahr was mainly being defended by the heavily outnumbered Takavaran, some units of the 92nd Armoured Division, the Pasdaran, and local civilian militias.

Battle of Khorramshahr (1982).headline: Bitka za Horamšahr (1982)
paragraphs: Druga bitka za Horamšahr, v Iranu znana tudi kot osvoboditev Horamšahra (perzijsko: Âzâdsâzī-ye Khorramshahr), je bila iranska ponovna osvojitev mesta Horamšahr 24. maja 1982, med iransko-iraško vojno. Iračani so mesto zavzeli prej v vojni, 26. oktobra 1980, kmalu po iraškem vdoru v Iran. Uspešna ponovna osvojitev je bila del iranske operacije Bejt ol Mokadas. Velja za prelomnico vojne, osvoboditev mesta pa v Iranu vsako leto praznujejo 24. maja.

source.title: Battle of Khorramshahr (1982)
paragraphs: The Second Battle of Khorramshahr, also known in Iran as the Liberation of Khorramshahr (Persian: آزادسازی خرمشهر, romanized: Âzâdsâzī-ye Khorramshahr) was the Iranian recapture of the city of Khorramshahr on 24 May 1982, during the Iran–Iraq War. The city had been captured by the Iraqis earlier in the war, on 26 October 1980, shortly after the Iraqi invasion of Iran. The successful retaking of the city was part of Iran's Operation Beit ol-Moqaddas. It is perceived as a turning point in the war; and the liberation of the city is annually celebrated in Iran on 24 May.

Battle of Kirkuk (2017).headline: Bitka za Kirkuk (2017)
paragraphs: Bitka za Kirkuk, s kodnim imenom operacija Uveljavljanje varnosti, v iraško-kurdskem spopadu leta 2017, je bila vojaška napotitev iraških varnostnih sil za ponovno zavzetje guvernorata Kirkuk, ki so ga držali pešmerge; ti so namreč prezrli ponavljajoča se opozorila, naj se umaknejo, kar je sprožilo spopade med silama. Prodor se je začel 15. oktobra 2017, mesto Kirkuk pa so iraške sile znova zavzele takoj ob vstopu, saj so Kurdi nemudoma pobegnili. Pet dni pozneje je bil ves guvernorat pod popolnim nadzorom iraških sil, druge iraške sile pa so v naslednjih dneh napredovale naprej in porazile pešmerge na obsežnih območjih severnega Iraka.

source.title: Battle of Kirkuk (2017)
paragraphs: The Battle of Kirkuk, codenamed Operation Enforcing Security of the 2017 Iraqi–Kurdish conflict, was a military deployment by the Iraqi Security Forces to retake Kirkuk Governorate from the Peshmerga after the latter ignored repeated warnings to withdraw, sparking clashes between the two forces. The advance began on 15 October 2017, with the city of Kirkuk being retaken upon entry of the Iraqi forces as the Kurds fled immediately. Five days later the entirety of the governorate was under full control of the Iraqi forces; meanwhile, other Iraqi forces continued their advances in subsequent days, defeating the Peshmerga forces across vast swathes of territory in northern Iraq.

Battle of Lake Huleh (1157).headline: Bitka pri jezeru Hula (1157)
paragraphs: V bitki pri jezeru Hula junija 1157 je Nur ad Din Zengi, emir Alepa in Damaska, iz zasede napadel in hudo porazil križarsko vojsko pod vodstvom jeruzalemskega kralja Balduina III. Kralj in nekaj bojevnikov se je umaknilo v bližnji grad, veliko pa jih je bilo ubitih ali ujetih. Latinsko Jeruzalemsko kraljestvo se je izognilo hujši škodi, ker je nasprotnik zbolel in zmage ni mogel izkoristiti. Dolina Hula leži na severovzhodu današnjega Izraela, v času bitke pa je pripadala Jeruzalemskemu kraljestvu.

source.title: Battle of Lake Huleh (1157)
paragraphs: In the Battle of Lake Huleh in June 1157, a Crusader army led by King Baldwin III of Jerusalem was ambushed and badly defeated by Nur ad-Din Zangi, the emir of Aleppo and Damascus. While the king and some fighting men escaped to a nearby castle, a large number were killed or made prisoner. The Latin Kingdom of Jerusalem escaped worse damage when their adversary became ill and was unable to follow up his victory. The Hula Valley is located in the northeast part of modern-day Israel. At the time of the battle, the area belonged to the Kingdom of Jerusalem.

Battle of Latakia.headline: Bitka pri Latakiji
paragraphs: Bitka pri Latakiji (arabsko: معركة اللاذقية; hebrejsko: קרב לטקיה) je bil majhen, a prelomen pomorski spopad jomkipurske vojne, ki je 7. oktobra 1973 potekal med Izraelom in Sirijo. Bila je prva pomorska bitka v zgodovini, v kateri so se spopadli raketni čolni z izstrelki površje-površje in v kateri so uporabili elektronsko zavajanje.

source.title: Battle of Latakia
paragraphs: The Battle of Latakia (Arabic: معركة اللاذقية; Hebrew: קרב לטקיה) was a small but revolutionary naval action of the Yom Kippur War, fought on 7 October 1973 between Israel and Syria. It was the first naval battle in history to see combat between surface-to-surface missile-equipped missile boats and the use of electronic deception.

Battle of Marj al-Saffar (1303).headline: Bitka pri Mardž al Safarju (1303)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mardž al Safarju (ali Mardž al Sufarju), znana tudi kot bitka pri Šakhabu, je od 20. do 22. aprila 1303 potekala med egiptovskimi mameluki ter Mongoli in njihovimi armenskimi zavezniki blizu Kisveja v Siriji, tik južno od Damaska. Bitka je vplivna tako v islamski zgodovini kot v sedanjosti zaradi spornega džihada proti drugim muslimanom in fatev o ramadanu, ki jih je izdal Ibn Tajmija. Katastrofalni poraz Mongolov je končal mongolske vdore v Levant.

source.title: Battle of Marj al-Saffar (1303)
paragraphs: The Battle of Marj al-Saffar (or Marj al-Suffar), also known as the Battle of Shaqhab, took place on April 20 through April 22, 1303 between the Egyptian Mamluks and the Mongols and their Armenian allies near Kiswe, Syria, just south of Damascus. The battle has been influential in both Islamic history and contemporary time because of the controversial jihad against other Muslims and Ramadan related fatwas issued by Ibn Taymiyyah. The battle, a disastrous defeat for the Mongols, put an end to Mongol invasions of the Levant.

Battle of Marj Ayyun.headline: Bitka pri Mardž Ajunu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mardž Ajunu je bil vojaški spopad pri Mardž Ajunu blizu reke Litani (v današnjem Libanonu) junija 1179 med Jeruzalemskim kraljestvom pod vodstvom Balduina IV. in ajubidskimi vojskami pod vodstvom Saladina. Končala se je z odločilno zmago muslimanov in velja za prvo v dolgi vrsti islamskih zmag nad kristjani pod Saladinom. Krščanskega kralja Balduina IV. Jeruzalemskega, ki ga je hromila gobavost, je rešila telesna straža in je za las ušel ujetju.

source.title: Battle of Marj Ayyun
paragraphs: The Battle of Marj Ayyun was a military confrontation fought at Marj Ayyun near the Litani River (modern-day Lebanon) in June 1179 between the Kingdom of Jerusalem under Baldwin IV and the Ayyubid armies under the leadership of Saladin. It ended in a decisive victory for the Muslims and is considered the first in the long series of Islamic victories under Saladin against the Christians. However, the Christian King, Baldwin IV of Jerusalem, who was crippled by leprosy, was saved by his bodyguard and narrowly escaped capture.

Battle of Marj Dabiq.headline: Bitka pri Mardž Dabiku
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mardž Dabiku (arabsko: مرج دابق, »travnik Dabik«; turško: Mercidabık Muharebesi), odločilni vojaški spopad v zgodovini Bližnjega vzhoda, je potekala 24. avgusta 1516 blizu kraja Dabik, 44 km severno od Alepa (v današnji Siriji). Bitka je bila del vojne med Osmanskim cesarstvom in mameluškim sultanatom v letih 1516–1517, ki se je končala z osmansko zmago, osvojitvijo večjega dela Bližnjega vzhoda in uničenjem mameluškega sultanata. Osmanska zmaga je Selimovim vojskam dala nadzor nad vso pokrajino Sirijo in odprla pot do osvojitve Egipta.

source.title: Battle of Marj Dabiq
paragraphs: The Battle of Marj Dābiq (Arabic: مرج دابق, meaning "the meadow of Dābiq"; Turkish: Mercidabık Muharebesi), a decisive military engagement in Middle Eastern history, was fought on 24 August 1516, near the town of Dabiq, 44 km north of Aleppo (modern Syria). The battle was part of the 1516–17 war between the Ottoman Empire and the Mamluk Sultanate, which ended in an Ottoman victory and conquest of much of the Middle East and brought about the destruction of the Mamluk Sultanate. The Ottoman victory in the battle gave Selim's armies control of the entire region of Syria and opened the door to the conquest of Egypt.

Battle of Marj Rahit (684).headline: Bitka pri Mardž Rahitu (684)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mardž Rahitu (arabsko: Yawm Marj Rāhiṭ) je bila ena zgodnjih bitk druge fitne. Potekala je 18. avgusta 684 med vojskami jemenske plemenske zveze, v kateri so prevladovali Kalbiti in ki je podpirala Omajade pod kalifom Mervanom I., ter Kajsiti pod vodstvom al Dahaka ibn Kajsa al Fihrija, ki so podpirali kalifa Abd Alaha ibn al Zubajra s sedežem v Meki. Odločilna omajadska zmaga je utrdila njihovo oblast nad Sirijo in jim utrla pot do končne zmage v vojni proti Zubajridom. Zapustila pa je tudi grenko dediščino razkola in rivalstva med Kajsiti in Jemenci, ki je bila do konca Omajadskega kalifata nenehen vir sporov in nestabilnosti.

source.title: Battle of Marj Rahit (684)
paragraphs: The Battle of Marj Rahit (Arabic: يوم مرج راهط, romanized: Yawm Marj Rāhiṭ) was one of the early battles of the Second Fitna. It was fought on 18 August 684 between the Kalb-dominated armies of the Yaman tribal confederation, supporting the Umayyads under Caliph Marwan I, and the Qays under al-Dahhak ibn Qays al-Fihri, who supported the Mecca-based Caliph Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr. The decisive Umayyad victory consolidated their power over Syria, paving the way for their eventual victory in the war against the Zubayrids. However, it also left a bitter legacy of division and rivalry between the Qays and the Yaman, which would be a constant source of strife and instability for the remainder of the Umayyad Caliphate.

Battle of Maysalun.headline: Bitka pri Majsalunu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Majsalunu (arabsko: معركة ميسلون), znana tudi kot bitka v prelazu Majsalun ali bitka pri Kan Majsalunu (francosko: Bataille de Khan Mayssaloun), je bila štiriurna bitka med silami Arabskega kraljestva Sirija in francosko Levantsko armado 24. julija 1920 blizu Majsaluna v gorovju Antilibanon, okoli 25 kilometrov zahodno od Damaska.

Oktobra 1918 so arabski uporniki pod vodstvom hašemitskega emirja Fejsala med arabskim uporom proti Osmanskemu cesarstvu, ki ga je podpirala Britanija, zavzeli Damask. Fejsal je nato pod okriljem zavezniške vojaške okupacijske uprave »OETA East« v skladu s prejšnjim angleško-francoskim sporazumom sestavil vlado. Ko so francoske sile vstopile v deželo, so naletele na krajevne upore, marca 1920 pa so Fejsala razglasili za kralja Sirije. Mesec pozneje je Društvo narodov Sirijo kot mandat dodelilo Franciji.

source.title: Battle of Maysalun
paragraphs: The Battle of Maysalun (Arabic: معركة ميسلون), also known as the Battle of Maysalun Pass or the Battle of Khan Maysalun (French: Bataille de Khan Mayssaloun), was a four-hour battle fought between the forces of the Arab Kingdom of Syria and the French Army of the Levant on 24 July 1920 near Maysalun in the Anti-Lebanon Mountains, about 25 kilometres (16 mi) west of Damascus.

In October 1918, Arab rebels, under Hashemite Emir Faisal, captured Damascus during the British-backed Arab Revolt against the Ottoman Empire. Faisal then formed a government under the auspices of the Allied military occupation administration of "OETA East", consistent with an earlier Anglo-French agreement. The French encountered local revolts when their forces entered the country, and in March 1920, Faisal was proclaimed King of Syria. A month later, the League of Nations allocated Syria to France as a mandate.

Battle of Mecca (1916).headline: Bitka za Meko (1916)
paragraphs: Bitka za Meko je junija in julija 1916 potekala v muslimanskem svetem mestu Meka. Mekanski šarif Husein bin Ali, voditelj klana Banu Hašim, je 10. junija iz tega mesta sprožil upor proti osmanskemu kalifatu. Bitka za Meko je bila del arabskega upora v prvi svetovni vojni.

source.title: Battle of Mecca (1916)
paragraphs: The Battle of Mecca occurred in the Muslim holy city of Mecca in June and July 1916. On June 10, the Sharif of Mecca, Hussein bin Ali, the leader of the Banu Hashim clan, started a revolt against the Ottoman Caliphate from this city. The Battle of Mecca was part of the Arab Revolt of World War I.

Battle of Megiddo (1918).headline: Bitka pri Megidu (1918)
paragraphs: Bitka pri Megidu je med 19. in 25. septembrom 1918 potekala na ravnini Šaron pred Tulkaremom, Tabsorjem in Araro v Judejskem gričevju ter na ravnini Esdrelon pri Nazaretu, Afuli, Bejsanu, Džaninu in Samahu. Ime, ki ga opisujejo kot »morda zavajajoče«, saj so pri Tel Megidu potekali le zelo omejeni boji, je izbral britanski poveljnik Edmund Allenby zaradi njegovega svetopisemskega in simbolnega odmeva.

source.title: Battle of Megiddo (1918)
paragraphs: The Battle of Megiddo was fought between 19 and 25 September 1918, on the Plain of Sharon, in front of Tulkarm, Tabsor and Arara in the Judean Hills as well as on the Esdralon Plain at Nazareth, Afulah, Beisan, Jenin and Samakh. Its name, which has been described as "perhaps misleading" since very limited fighting took place near Tel Megiddo, was chosen by British commander Edmund Allenby for its biblical and symbolic resonance.

Battle of Megiddo (609 BC).headline: Bitka pri Megidu (609 pr. n. št.)
paragraphs: Ta bitka pri Megidu je po virih potekala leta 609 pr. n. št., ko je egiptovski faraon Neho II. vodil vojsko proti Karkemišu (v severni Siriji), da bi se pridružil zaveznikom, zatonu zapisanemu Novoasirskemu cesarstvu, proti vzpenjajočemu se Novobabilonskemu cesarstvu. Pri tem je moral prečkati ozemlje Kraljestva Juda. Judovski kralj Josija Egipčanov ni hotel spustiti skozi.
